src: 越通社河内——越通社特派记者报道，在访问文莱达鲁萨兰国期间，2月11日上午，越南政府总理范明政与夫人走访了文莱达鲁萨兰大学（UBD，简称“文莱大学”）。
raw: Vietnamese Prime Minister Nguyen Tan Dung and his wife visited the University of Brunei Darussalam (UBD) on the morning of February 11 during his visit to Brunei.

src: 文莱大学是文莱最大的高等高等教育和科学研究中心，在本地区大学排行榜上位居第三。
raw: University of Brunei Darussalam is the largest center of higher education and scientific research in Brunei, and ranks third in the university ranking in the region.

src: 文莱大学是越南与文莱在教育培训合作中的象征之一。
raw: The University of Brunei Darussalam is one of the symbols of Vietnam-Brunei cooperation in education and training.

src: 文莱大学于2013年7月正式与越南FPT大学建立合作关系，主要合作领域是英语培训。
raw: The University of Brunei Darussalam officially established a cooperative relationship with Vietnam FPT University in July 2013, and the main cooperation area is English training.

src: 除了英语、法语、德育、日语和韩语等外语外，文莱大学还将越南语纳入教学课程。
raw: In addition to English, French, German, Japanese, and Korean, the University of Brunei Darussalam has also included Vietnamese in its curriculum.

src: 走访文莱大学时，越南政府总理范明政和夫人同越南语班的学生进行了交流。
raw: During the visit to the University of Brunei Darussalam, the Prime Minister of Vietnam Nguyen Tan Dung and his wife had an exchange with students of Vietnamese language class.

src: 范明政总理为越来越多的外国人喜欢学习越南语而感到高兴，进而为把越南文化特色和风土人情形象推广到世界各地作出积极贡献。
raw: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh is happy that more and more foreigners are learning Vietnamese, and he will actively contribute to promoting the image of Vietnamese culture and local characteristics to the world.

src: 政府总理范明政表示相信并希望文莱大学的越南语教师队伍日益强大；越南语班的学员越来越对越南语感兴趣，努力学习，能够早日使用流利的越南语，并成为越文两国友好合作关系的使者。
raw: The Prime Minister of the Government, Pheung Amnim, expressed his belief and hope that the Vietnamese language teacher team of University of Brunei Darussalam would become stronger and stronger; the students of Vietnamese class would be more and more interested in Vietnamese language, and would strive to learn it fluently as soon as possible, and become the messenger of the friendly cooperation between Vietnam and Brunei.

src: 趁此机会，范明政总理还通过视频方式与正在岘港市FPT-UBD全球中心学习英语的越南学生进行交流，了解他们特别是在疫情期间的学习情况。
raw: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh also took the opportunity to communicate with Vietnamese students studying English at FPT-UBD Global Center in Chanh Muong District, Quang Nam Province, via video, to learn about their learning situation, especially during the pandemic.

src: 政府总理范明政认为，越南FPT大学与文莱大学之间的合作关系特别是FPT-UBD全球中心是越南与文莱教育合作关系中的生动象征。
raw: The Prime Minister of Vietnam, Nguyen Tan Dung, believed that the cooperation relationship between Vietnam FPT University and Brunei University, especially the FPT-UBD Global Center, was a vivid symbol of the cooperation between Vietnam and Brunei in education.

src: 同时希望该中心的学生在学习中取得更大的进步，为越文两国友好合作关系作出积极的贡献。
raw: At the same time, we hope that the students of the center will make greater progress in their studies and make positive contributions to the friendly and cooperative relations between Vietnam and the two countries.

src: 范明政总理在与文莱教育部部长和文莱大学领导展开讨论时高度评价两国在教育合作中所取得的成效，其中包括FPT大学与文莱大学之间的合作，以及文莱大学将越南语纳入教学课程这一举措。
raw: Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh highly appreciated the achievements of the two countries in education cooperation during his discussions with the Minister of Education of Brunei and leaders of Brunei University. These achievements include the cooperation between FPT University and Brunei University, as well as the initiative of Brunei University to include Vietnamese language in the teaching curriculum.

src: 范明政总理希望文莱大学将继续关注确保越南语教学质量并进一步扩大越南语班的规模。
raw: Prime Minister Lim Jong-hyeon hopes that the University of Brunei Darussalam will continue to pay attention to ensuring the quality of Vietnamese language teaching and further expand the scale of Vietnamese language classes.

src: 越南政府总理范明政还高度评价两国在于2014年4月签署的教育合作谅解备忘录基础上的合作所取得的积极成效；建议文莱继续提供更多的奖学金并有效开展各项短期互换培训项目，如：环球探索项目（Global Discovery Programme）、探索之年（Discovery Year）等。
raw: The Prime Minister of Vietnam, Nguyen Tan Dung, also highly evaluated the positive effects of cooperation between the two countries on the basis of the Memorandum of Understanding on Educational Cooperation signed in April 2014; he suggested that Brunei continue to provide more scholarships and effectively carry out various short-term exchange training projects, such as the Global Discovery Programme and the Discovery Year.

src: 范明政总理高度赞赏文莱大学在越南设立其在东南亚第一个分校；相信该大学在地区和世界上的发展规模日益强大；进一步扩大与越南高等院校的合作关系。
raw: Prime Minister Prayut Chan-o-cha highly appreciated the establishment of the first branch of the University of Brunei Darussalam in Vietnam; he believed that the university would become stronger in terms of regional and world development; and he hoped to further expand cooperation with Vietnamese higher education institutions.

src: 借此机会，范明政总理和夫人在文莱大学校园内种下纪念树，并在纪念簿上留言。
raw: Prime Minister and Mrs. Fan Mingcheng planted a commemorative tree in the campus of the University of Brunei Darussalam and left a message in the commemorative book.

src: 范明政总理祝愿文莱大学不断向前发展，为文莱的教育事业贡献越来越大的力量，并且与越南各所教育培训机构开展更深更广的合作。
raw: Prime Minister Lim has wished that the University of Brunei Darussalam will continue to develop and contribute more power to the education industry of Brunei, and develop deeper and broader cooperation with Vietnam's educational and training institutions.

src: ”西班牙知名中国问题专家、中国政策观察网名誉顾问胡里奥·里奥斯日前接受本报记者采访时表示，当前中国疫情防控进入新阶段，经济社会发展活力将进一步得到释放。

src: 里奥斯表示，面对各种超预期因素冲击，中国以非凡的经济治理经验和措施沉着应对，充分体现出其经济韧性和管理水平。

src: 每年中国全国两会召开，代表委员共商国家发展大计、共议民生热点问题，广泛凝聚共识、凝聚人心、凝聚智慧，为中国发展增添力量。

src: 国际社会期待中国智慧和中国方案，期待中国发展为世界带来新机遇。

src: ”里奥斯说，当前中国正全力推动科技创新，为经济社会发展注入新动力，“资金投入、人才培养、政策激励，这让中国在新的五年规划中继续充满活力”。

src: 在里奥斯看来，经济体制改革对任何国家来说都是一项艰巨的任务。

src: 在中国共产党领导下，中国既发挥市场经济的长处，又发挥社会主义制度的优越性，采取积极主动措施稳定经济。

src: 围绕扩大内需的战略基点，加大金融支持实体经济的力度，支持民营、中小企业和制造业发展，坚持创新发展，促进就业、提高中国民众的收入和生活水平，满足人民多层次多样化消费需求……中国完整、准确、全面贯彻新发展理念，着力推动高质量发展，构建新发展格局，将为世界带来更多增长机遇。

src: 健身行业应摆脱信任危机-中新网
raw: Fitness industry should get rid of trust crisis - chinanews.com

src: 又一大型健身房“暴雷”？
raw: Another large gym “bankruptcy”?

src: 近日，知名健身机构中健健身会员维权问题引起社会关注。
raw: Recently, the issue of protecting the rights of members of a well-known fitness institution, Zhongxin Fitness, has attracted social attention.

src: 春节后不少会员发现自己所在门店没有正常营业，随后，关于该机构倒闭跑路的传闻引起会员恐慌，导致公安、人社部门介入。
raw: After the Spring Festival, many members found that their stores were not operating normally. Subsequently, rumors about the agency going bankrupt and running away caused members to panic, leading to the involvement of public security and social welfare departments.

src: 最后，该机构相关负责人出面回应，承诺会努力保障好员工和会员的合法权益，风波才得以平息。
raw: Finally, the relevant person in charge of the agency came forward to respond, promising to strive to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees and members, and the storm was finally calmed down.

src: 个别健身机构的部分门店出现经营问题，暂时关闭，消费者本可心平气和等待问题解决，为何不少会员的第一反应是“大事不妙”？
raw: Some fitness institutions have temporarily closed some of their branches due to operational problems. Consumers could have waited for the problems to be solved calmly. Why did many members' first reaction be "something is wrong"?

src: 健身俱乐部会员维权风波背后，是行业信任危机的深层次问题。
raw: The fitness club member's legal battle is a deep-seated problem of industry trust crisis.

src: 国内传统健身房普遍采取预付费模式，“赚用户不来的钱”是其发展的底层逻辑。
raw: In China, traditional gyms generally adopt a prepaid payment model, and “making money from users who don’t come” is the underlying logic of its development.

src: 通过预售会员卡获取现金流，不断开新店，看似能够循环往复，实则寅吃卯粮，无法形成稳定的盈利模式。
raw: By obtaining cash flow through pre-sale of membership cards and opening new stores, it seems that the cycle can be repeated, but in fact, it is eating the rice of the other, and it is impossible to form a stable profit model.

src: 健身房跑路等行业负面信息频频传出，对消费者信心造成强烈冲击。
raw: The frequent negative news of gyms and other industries closing down has a strong impact on consumer confidence.

src: 从市场前景看，健身房当然算得上是一门有“钱途”的好生意。
raw: From the market prospect, gyms are certainly a good business with “money making” potential.

src: 健身赛道虽然起起伏伏，但始终受到资本关注。
raw: The fitness track has been up and down, but it has always been the focus of capital.

src: 多项数据显示，文体消费等领域热度不断攀升，市场持续回暖。
raw: According to various data, the popularity of sports and cultural consumption has been increasing, and the market has been recovering steadily.

src: 具体到健身市场，随着居民生活水平稳步提高，健康生活理念深入人心，健身行业发展大有可为。
raw: Specifically in the fitness market, with the steady improvement of residents’ living standards, the concept of healthy living has entered people’s hearts, and the fitness industry has great potential for development.

src: 形势越是趋好，行业越需重视发展质量。
raw: The better the situation, the more the industry needs to pay attention to the quality of development.

src: 然而，个别机构对消费复苏后的健身市场盲目乐观，刚从危机中走出来，又吹响开疆拓土的号角，把融资资金一股脑投入新店建设上。
raw: However, some institutions are overly optimistic about the fitness market after the recovery of consumption, and just after coming out of the crisis, they are blowing the horn of expanding the market and investing all the funds in the construction of new stores.

src: 不可否认，这几年受疫情影响，不少机构退出，行业重新洗牌，有实力的企业此时选择性地加大收购力度、重新布局，未尝不是新机遇。
raw: It is undeniable that in recent years, many institutions have withdrawn due to the epidemic, and the industry has undergone a reshuffle. At this time, powerful enterprises choose to increase the acquisition intensity and reorganize, which is a new opportunity.

src: 但是，健身市场发展要想进入良性循环，迈上行稳致远的康庄大道，行业就必须改变传统模式，改变经营策略。
raw: However, in order to develop into a virtuous cycle and move towards a prosperous future, the fitness industry must change its traditional model and business strategy.

src: 只有稳扎稳打，重新建立起消费者的信任度、安全感，才能真正赢得市场、赢得未来。
raw: Only by standing firm and rebuilding consumers' confidence and sense of security can we truly win the market and win the future.

src: 相比大建新店抢占市场，健身行业当前更需要的是沉下心来优化服务，用高质量发展来稳住用户。
raw: Compared to the market capture of Big Health Club, the fitness industry currently needs to calm down and optimize services, and stabilize users with high-quality development.

src: 首先，要靠服务留住用户。
raw: First, we need to rely on services to retain users.

src: 健身房属于服务行业，其本质是坚持“用户导向”，要紧紧围绕用户需求，把经营重心放在服务提质升级上。
raw: Gyms belong to the service industry, and their essence is to adhere to “user orientation”. They should focus on the needs of users and improve the quality of services.

src: 其次，要靠数字化转型提升用户体验。
raw: Secondly, digital transformation is necessary to improve user experience.

src: 比如当下流行的互联网健身房模式，实现用户按次付费和场地自选。
raw: For example, the popular Internet fitness center model, which realizes pay-per-use and site selection for users.

src: 同时，身体数据、运动数据得以有效利用，还可以满足社交需求，实现从线上到线下完整的服务闭环。
raw: At the same time, the effective utilization of body data and sports data can also meet the social needs and realize the complete service loop from online to offline.

src: 没有私教推销，没有巨额年卡，用户对健身机构“跑路”的担忧降低了，信任感也就提升了。
raw: Without private coaching and huge annual fees, users’ concerns about “running away” from gyms have been reduced, and their trust in gyms has been improved.

src: 另外，还要积极探索多元业态。
raw: In addition, we should actively explore multiple business models.

src: 如今，体育消费已经从单一服务走向场景消费，健身俱乐部有望成为消费新入口，围绕健身所需的运动补给和健身器械等周边产品或将成为新的盈利点，为消费者提供更丰富选择。
raw: Nowadays, sports consumption has moved from single service to scene consumption, and fitness clubs are expected to become a new entry point for consumption. Surrounding products such as sports supplements and fitness equipment required for exercise will become a new source of profit, providing consumers with more choices.

raw: Buy cheap and return the difference!

src: 南京楼市再现“差价赔付”-中新网
raw: Nanjing Real Estate Market Reappears “Price Difference Compensation” - CNTV

src: 扬子晚报讯(记者 马祚波)扬子晚报/紫牛新闻记者10日在采访中发现，十余年未见的“保价协议”又重回了南京楼市，位于江北新区的一家楼盘宣称“差价赔付”，在交房前其他房源的优惠大于之前的折扣，开发商愿意为买房人换房并退还差价。
raw: According to a report by Yangzhou Evening News/Qiwei News, a journalist found out during an interview that the “protection agreement” which had not been seen for more than ten years had returned to the Nanjing real estate market. A property developer in the Nanjing New Area claimed to “pay for the difference” and offered a discount on other properties before the handover of the property, and the developer was willing to switch the property with the buyer and return the difference.

src: “保价协议”条件可不少
raw: “Buy-back agreement” conditions are not few

src: 这家位于江北新区的楼盘名为保利扬子萃云台，看房人孙先生告诉记者，他在上周末逛楼盘时发现了一则“声明”。
raw: The building is named as Poly Jiangzi Xi Yuntai, and the person who came to see the house, Mr. Sun, told the reporter that he found a “statement” when he visited the building last weekend.

src: 他发给记者的图片上显示，该楼盘的开发商承诺，凡是在2月1日-2月28日期间购买房源的，自双方签订买卖合同之日起至对应房源交付，若该项目其他房源的优惠折扣大于之前购房所享折扣的(限与该商品房属于同一户型、同一楼栋、同一单元、同一物业类型的其他未售商品房)，开发商可以为购房者换房并退还差价。
raw: The pictures he sent to reporters showed that the developer of the property promised that if the buyer purchased the property between February 1 and February 28, the developer would switch the property and return the difference if there was a better discount on other properties of the same type (limited to other unsold properties of the same floor plan, same building, same unit, and same property type).

src: 孙先生表示，置业顾问表示这其实就是一份“保价协议”，目的是让买家放心出手，不用担心开发企业降价促销，“现在就怕买完了它就降价了，去售楼处闹吧没时间，不闹的话也确实窝心”。
raw: Mr. Sun said that the real estate consultant said that this was actually a "price protection agreement", which was intended to reassure buyers that they did not have to worry about the developer reducing the price for a sale promotion, "Now I'm afraid that it will be reduced in price after I buy it. I don't have time to go to the sales office to make trouble. If I don't make trouble, I will feel relieved."

src: 还有不少买房人则认为，“保价协议”虽然是在给购房者吃“定心丸”，不过条件却不低。
raw: Many home buyers also believe that the “protection agreement” is a kind of “assurance” for home buyers, but the conditions are not low.

src: 打算在江北买一套刚需房的郑女士说，保价的房源首先是要同一户型，还得在同一楼栋、同一个单元，买家可以比价的房源寥寥，因此“门槛”还是蛮高的。
raw: Ms. Zheng, who intends to buy a first-time home in Jiangbei, said that the properties with protection clause must be of the same type, in the same building and the same unit. There are not many properties for comparison, and the "threshold" is high.

src: 也有购房者认为，由于信息不对称，销售时不排除给出额外的让利，买家“维权”的难度不小。
raw: Some home buyers also think that because of information asymmetry, the seller may give additional discounts, and it is not easy for buyers to “stand up for their rights”.

src: 能否留住买房人有待观察
raw: Whether it is possible to keep the buyers of the house is to be observed.

src: 记者在南京网上房地产上查询得知，该楼盘于去年11月首领两幢楼共计252套房源的销许，户型面积有105平方米、114平方米、129平方米等，全装修销许均价为39843元/㎡。
raw: A reporter inquired about the property on Ningbo's online real estate website and found that the two buildings of the project, with a total of 252 units, were sold in November last year. The unit areas were 105 square meters, 114 square meters, and 129 square meters, and the selling price of fully furnished units was 39,843 yuan/square meter.

src: 不过两个多月过去，网上房地产显示目前该楼盘的未售总套数为157套，占比为62.3%，其中8号楼共计128套，未售套数达113套，7号楼的124套中也有44套未售，项目的总成交套数只有33套，占比仅为13%。
raw: However, more than two months have passed, and the online real estate shows that the total number of unsold units in the project is currently 157 units, accounting for 62.3%, of which 128 units are in block 8, and the total number of unsold units is 113; 44 units are unsold in block 7, which has 124 units; the total number of transactions in the project is only 33 units, accounting for only 13%.

src: 市场人士介绍，“保价协议”在2008年也曾在南京出现过。
raw: Market people introduced that "protection agreement" also appeared in Nanjing in 2008.

src: 当年8月份，河西黄山路上的楼盘横塘西苑为了吸引买房人眼球，推出了《保价计划》，具体内容为“公司郑重承诺，若一年内项目优惠幅度扩大，由此产生的差额，公司将按差额退还给老业主”。
raw: In August of that year, the Lushan West Garden in Heqing Road launched a "protection plan" to attract buyers. The specific content was "the company solemnly promises that if the discount range of the project is expanded within one year, the company will refund the difference to the old owners according to the difference."

src: 此后2011年4月，南京也有9家楼盘拿出部分房源承诺“差价赔付”。
raw: In April 2011, nine properties in Nanjing also promised to “compensate for the difference” with a portion of their properties.

src: “楼市在回暖，此时更需要一针‘强心剂’。
raw: “The property market is recovering, and we need a ‘stimulant’ at this time. ”

src: ”南京地产行业一位资深操盘手沈先生表示，“保价协议”也是房企的营销方式之一。
raw: "The 'protection agreement' is also one of the marketing methods of real estate companies," said Shen, a senior operator in the real estate industry in Nanjing.

src: 他认为如今开发企业比买房人更需要信心，推出“保价协议”其实也是在给其打气。
raw: He believed that developers now need more confidence than home buyers, and the launch of the “protection agreement” is actually to boost their confidence.

src: 至于能否留住买房人，他表示这取决于调控政策、贷款门槛等多重因素的影响，就目前来看仍有待观察。
raw: As for whether the buyers of the houses can stay, he said that it depends on the influence of multiple factors such as the control policies and the loan threshold, and it is still to be observed at present.

src: 中国救援队在土耳其持续开展救援行动 已营救4名被困人员-中新网
raw: China's rescue team continues rescue operation in Turkey, 4 people trapped have been rescued - chinanews.com

src: 中新网2月11日电 据应急管理部网站11日消息，2月10日，正在土耳其搜救的中国救援队派出3个行动分队、45名救援队员，营救出1名被困人员。
raw: China Rescue Team dispatched three operation teams and 45 rescuers to search and rescue in Turkey on February 10, and rescued one person who was trapped.

src: 同时派出2个搜索评估组，对沃达巴什大街15栋建筑进行评估排查。
raw: At the same time, two search and assessment teams were sent to assess and investigate the 15 buildings on Vodabashi Street.

src: 截至目前，共营救4名被困人员，搜寻出5名遇难者，对25栋倒塌严重的建筑进行生命迹象和风险评估。
raw: As of now, a total of 4 people were rescued, 5 people were found dead, and life signs and risk assessment were conducted on 25 collapsed buildings.

src: 救援队将根据灾区实际和救援现场情况，科学调整救援力量，持续深入开展救援工作。
raw: The rescue team will adjust the rescue force scientifically according to the actual situation of the disaster area and the rescue scene, and continue to carry out rescue work in depth.

src: 救援队通过使馆、当地政府、联合国救援组织等多种渠道获取救援求助信息，通过线上询情、现场搜索等多种方式进行逐一核实。
raw: The rescue team obtained the information of the rescue request through various channels such as the embassy, local government, and the United Nations rescue organization, and verified it one by one through online inquiries and on-site searches.

src: 向中国香港救援队介绍目前救援环境和建筑坍塌等情况，联合开展搜索行动。
raw: Introduce the current rescue environment and the collapse of buildings to the Hong Kong Rescue Team in China, and jointly carry out search operations.

src: 目前与意大利救援队联合负责区域协调(SSC5)，同时派遣3名队员参加5号区域救援协调中心工作，与意大利、英国、塞尔维亚、斯洛伐克、阿曼等多支队伍进行沟通，了解了联合国救援组织和各国救援队救援工作情况。
raw: Currently, it is responsible for regional coordination (SSC5) jointly with Italian rescue team, and 3 members are dispatched to participate in the work of the Rescue Coordination Center of Region No. 5. Communication is carried out with Italian, British, Serbian, Slovakian, Omani and other rescue teams to learn about the rescue work of the United Nations rescue organization and rescue teams of various countries.

src: 救援队持续强化安全管理和队伍保障，按照“统一指挥、安全第一”原则，加强救援现场安全管控，强化救援工作纪律要求，明确安全注意事项。
raw: The rescue team continued to strengthen safety management and team protection, strengthen safety control at the rescue scene in accordance with the principle of "unified command, safety first", strengthen rescue work discipline requirements, and clearly state safety precautions.

src: 持续运行轮值备勤和岗哨工作制度，强化营区安全管理。
raw: Establish a system of continuous on-call duty and guard duty, and strengthen the security management of the camp.

src: 救援队医疗人员每天为队员提供体检服务，加强重点人员医疗保障，目前救援队全员身体健康，开展营区消杀。
raw: The medical staff of the rescue team provides medical examination services for the team members every day, and strengthens the medical protection of key personnel. At present, all the members of the rescue team are in good health, and carry out disinfection in the camp.

src: 自营地建立后，后勤保障队员共搭建了指挥通信、装备存放、医疗洗消、生活住宿及犬舍等4大类26顶野战帐篷，保障现场救援装备30余套件。
raw: After the self-supporting camp was established, the logistics support team set up 26 tents in four categories, including command and communication, equipment storage, medical washing and disinfection, living quarters, and dog houses, to ensure the safety of the rescue equipment on the scene.

src: 金正恩父女互动亲密 老婆遭冷落一旁
raw: Kim Jong-un and his daughter interacted intimately, while his wife was left out

src: （综合11日电）朝鲜8日晚间举行建军节第75周年阅兵仪式，领导人金正恩的女儿金主爱不仅出席，还与父亲一同站上主席台。
raw: (Combined report on 11th) North Korea held a military parade on the 8th evening to celebrate the 75th anniversary of its founding. The daughter of the leader Kim Jong-un, Kim Ju-ae, not only attended the ceremony, but also stood on the podium with her father.

src: 朝鲜官媒9日公布影片，金主爱依偎在父亲身边，数次温情对视、讲悄悄话，她用双手轻捧老爸的脸颊，甚至摸著父亲胸口，父女互动画面播送至举国上下。
raw: On the 9th, the Korean official media released a video in which Kim Jong-un hugged his father, and they exchanged affectionate glances and whispered to each other several times. She gently held her father's cheek with her hands and even touched her father's chest. The interaction between father and daughter was broadcasted to the whole country.

src: 然而，第一夫人李雪主只能退到一旁。
raw: However, the first lady, Liu Yandong, had to stand aside.

src: 综合韩国“朝鲜新闻”等报导，金正恩、李雪主夫妇7日带著女儿金主爱出席晚宴的官方合照中，金主爱不仅罕见坐在父母正中间C位，在隔日晚间建军节第75周年阅兵仪式上，她还与金正恩一起登上主席台。
raw: According to the reports of “Korea News” and other Korean media, on the 7th, Kim Jong-un and his wife Ri Sol-ju brought their daughter Kim Ju-ae to attend the official photo of the banquet. Not only did Kim Ju-ae sit in the C position in the middle of her parents, which is rare, but she also stood on the podium with Kim Jong-un during the military parade on the 75th anniversary of the founding of the army the next evening.

src: 朝鲜官媒“朝鲜中央电视台”事后释出阅兵式影片，曝光了更多父女情深的画面。
raw: The Korean Central Television, a Korean official media, later released a film of the parade, revealing more scenes of deep father-daughter love.

src: 金正恩在主席台上数次与女儿对望，两人脸上的笑容从未退去，还互相在耳边讲悄悄话，金主爱一度以双手捧起老爸的两颊，金正恩也以灿笑回应。
raw: Kim Jong-un looked at his daughter several times from the podium, and the two of them never stopped smiling. They also whispered to each other in their ears. Kim Jong-un's daughter held her father's cheeks with her hands for a while, and Kim Jong-un smiled back.

src: 其他官媒画面也显示，金主爱与金正恩坐在室内沙发椅上时，用手不断摸著父亲的脸；她与父亲挽著手走路时，一边用手摸在金正恩的胸口。
raw: Other official media images also show that the master of gold, Ri Sol Ju, was touching her father's face while sitting on an indoor sofa; while walking with her father, she was touching his chest with her hand.

src: 而第一夫人李雪主全程只能走在后头或是坐在一旁，总是距离丈夫和女儿有几步之差。
raw: The first lady, Liu Xi, could only walk behind or sit beside him, and was always just a few steps away from her husband and daughter.

src: 韩国媒体指出，金主爱自去年11月18日试射火星17飞弹首次在公开露脸以来，3个月以来曝光机率越来越高，至今已是第5度出现于正式场合。
raw: According to the Korean media, Kim Jong-un has been increasingly exposed in public since the first time he appeared in public after the test-firing of the Mars-17 missile on November 18, 2017. This is the fifth time he has appeared in an official setting in the past three months.

src: 朝鲜官媒提及金主爱时使用了最亲爱的子弟、尊贵的子弟等极高尊称，也播出金主爱在看台上俯瞰阅兵行进时反覆高喊誓死拥护白头血统的片段。
raw: The North Korean official media used the highest honorifics such as beloved son and distinguished son when referring to Kim Jong-un. It also broadcasted the scene of Kim Jong-un repeatedly shouting his vow to die for the pure blood while looking down at the parade from the stand.

src: 这些迹象让外界怀疑金主爱是否已经被内定为金氏政权的继承人，《华盛顿邮报》分析认为“这是金正恩把中学年纪的女儿推上接班人地位的讯号”，不过也有观点认为，这样的判断仍为时过早，在金正恩膝下有儿子的情况中，仍保有各种可能性。
raw: These signs make people outside doubt whether the master of love has been predetermined as the successor of the Kim regime. The Washington Post analyzed that "this is a signal that Kim Jong-un has pushed his daughter, who is in middle school, to the position of the successor"; however, there is also a view that such judgment is too early, and there are still possibilities in the situation that Kim Jong-un has a son under his knee.

src: 新华社评论员：推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程——四论深刻领会习近平总书记在学习贯彻党的二十大精神研讨班开班式重要讲话-中新网
raw: Xinhua News Commentator: Promoting the modernization of China is a systematic project – four thoughts on deeply understanding the important speech of General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar on studying and implementing the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress – chinanews.com

src: 新华社北京2月11日电 题：推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程——四论深刻领会习近平总书记在学习贯彻党的二十大精神研讨班开班式重要讲话
raw: Xinhua News Agency Beijing February 11th Xinhua News Agency Beijing February 11th Title: Pushing forward the modernization of China is a systematic project – four thoughts on deeply understanding the important speech of General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar on studying and implementing the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress

src: 新华社评论员
raw: Xinhua News Commentator

src: “推进中国式现代化是一个系统工程，需要统筹兼顾、系统谋划、整体推进，正确处理好顶层设计与实践探索、战略与策略、守正与创新、效率与公平、活力与秩序、自立自强与对外开放等一系列重大关系。
raw: “Advancing the modernization of China is a systematic project, which needs to be planned comprehensively, systematically and as a whole, and correctly handle the relationship between top-level design and practical exploration, strategy and tactics, adherence to the right path and innovation, efficiency and fairness, vitality and order, self-reliance and opening up, etc.

src: ”在新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班开班式上，习近平总书记科学把握现代化建设规律，深入系统阐明实践中需要处理好的一系列重大关系，为我们大力推进中国式现代化提供了科学方法论。
raw: “In the opening ceremony of the Seminar on Learning and Implementing the Thought of Xi Jinping on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics in the New Era and the Spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress for the newly elected members of the CPC Central Committee, alternate members and provincial and ministerial leaders, Xi Jinping, the General Secretary, scientifically grasped the laws of modernization construction, and profoundly and systematically explained a series of major relationships that need to be handled in practice, providing a scientific methodology for us to vigorously promote the Chinese-style modernization.

src: 推进中国式现代化涉及经济、政治、文化、社会、生态文明等各个领域，关系治党治国治军、内政外交国防等方方面面，既要做好系统谋划，又要勇于改革创新，不断实现整体推进。
raw: The promotion of Chinese modernization involves various fields such as economy, politics, culture, society, and ecological civilization, and relates to the governance of the party, the country, and the military, as well as domestic and foreign policies, national defense, and so on. It is necessary to make systematic plans and be brave in innovation, and continuously achieve the overall promotion.

src: 进行顶层设计，需要深刻洞察世界发展大势，准确把握人民群众的共同愿望，深入探索经济社会发展规律，使制定的规划和政策体系体现时代性、把握规律性、富于创造性，做到远近结合、上下贯通、内容协调。
raw: Conduct top-level design, which requires profound insight into the trend of world development, accurate grasp of the common wishes of the people, in-depth exploration of the laws of economic and social development, and make the planned and policy system designed reflect the time, grasp the laws, and be creative, so as to achieve the combination of near and far, the connection of top and bottom, and the coordination of contents.

src: 推进中国式现代化是一个探索性事业，还有许多未知领域，需要在实践中去大胆探索，通过改革创新来推动事业发展，决不能刻舟求剑、守株待兔。
raw: Pushing forward the modernization of China is a venture of exploration, and there are many unknown areas that need to be dared to explore in practice, and drive the development of the industry through reform and innovation, and never be over-cautious.

src: 战略问题是一个政党、一个国家的根本性问题。
raw: Strategic issues are fundamental issues for a political party and a country.

src: 推进中国式现代化，要增强战略的前瞻性，以科学的战略预见未来、引领未来；要增强战略的全局性，着眼于解决事关党和国家事业兴衰成败、牵一发而动全身的重大问题；要增强战略的稳定性，战略一经形成，就要长期坚持、一抓到底、善作善成。
raw: To promote the modernization of China, we need to enhance the foresight of the strategy, to scientifically predict the future and lead the future; we need to enhance the overallness of the strategy, to focus on solving major problems that concern the prosperity and development of the party and the country, and to solve the problems that affect the whole body; we need to enhance the stability of the strategy, and once the strategy is formed, it should be persistently and unswervingly implemented.

src: 要科学把握战略和策略的辩证统一关系，把战略的原则性和策略的灵活性有机结合起来，灵活机动、随机应变、临机决断，在因地制宜、因势而动、顺势而为中把握战略主动。
raw: To scientifically grasp the dialectical unity of strategy and tactics, organically combine the principle of strategy and the flexibility of tactics, be flexible and mobile, adapt to changes, and make decisions on the spot, grasp the strategic initiative in adapting to local conditions, taking advantage of opportunities, and following the trend.

src: 中华民族是守正创新的民族。
raw: The Chinese nation is a nation that is both upright and innovative.

src: 处理好守正与创新的关系，既要守好中国式现代化的本和源、根和魂，毫不动摇坚持中国式现代化的中国特色、本质要求、重大原则，确保中国式现代化的正确方向，又要把创新摆在国家发展全局的突出位置，顺应时代发展要求，着眼于解决重大理论和实践问题，积极识变应变求变，大力推进改革创新，不断塑造发展新动能新优势，充分激发全社会创造活力。
raw: Handle the relationship between upholding the essence and source of Chinese modernization and innovation, and both uphold the essence and source of Chinese modernization and the fundamental requirements and major principles of Chinese modernization, and ensure the correct direction of Chinese modernization, and also put innovation in a prominent position in the overall situation of national development, meet the requirements of the times, focus on solving major theoretical and practical problems, actively seek changes and innovation, and vigorously promote reform and innovation, continuously create new impetus and advantages for development, and fully unleash the creative vitality of the whole society.

src: 效率是公平的重要基础，公平是效率的有力保证。
raw: Efficiency is an important basis for fairness, and fairness is a powerful guarantee for efficiency.

src: 我们推进中国式现代化，既要创造比资本主义更高的效率，又要更有效地维护社会公平，更好实现效率与公平相兼顾、相促进、相统一。
raw: We are advancing modernization in the Chinese way, which requires creating higher efficiency than that of capitalism and effectively maintaining social fairness, and better achieving the balance between efficiency and fairness, and the coordination, unity and harmony between them.

src: 处理好效率与公平的关系，不断实现发展为了人民、发展依靠人民、发展成果由人民共享，让现代化建设成果更多更公平惠及全体人民。
raw: By balancing efficiency and fairness, we will continuously achieve development for the people, development relying on the people, and development results shared by the people, so that the fruits of modernization will benefit more and more people in a more fair and equitable way.

src: 推进中国式现代化，需要处理好活力与秩序的关系，让社会既充满活力又安定有序。
raw: To promote modernization in the Chinese way, we need to handle the relationship between vitality and order, and make society full of vitality and orderly.

src: 要统筹好发展和安全两件大事，贯彻总体国家安全观，健全国家安全体系，增强维护国家安全能力，坚定维护国家政权安全、制度安全、意识形态安全和重点领域安全。
raw: It is necessary to coordinate the development and security, implement the overall national security concept, perfect the national security system, enhance the ability to safeguard national security, and firmly safeguard the security of the state power, system, ideology and security in key areas.

src: 既在发展中更多考虑安全因素，通过发展提升国家安全实力，运用发展成果来夯实国家安全的基础，又善于营造有利于经济社会发展的安全环境，不断激发发展活力，实现高质量发展和高水平安全的良性互动。
raw: While considering more security factors in development, improving national security strength through development, using the development achievements to consolidate the foundation of national security, and creating a safe environment for economic and social development, we will continuously stimulate the vitality of development, realize high-quality development and high-level security, and achieve a good interaction between them.

src: 推进中国式现代化，既要坚持走自己的路，又要拓展世界眼光，坚持对外开放，不断拓展中国式现代化的广度和深度。
raw: To promote the modernization of China, we must not only stick to our own path, but also broaden our horizons and keep an open mind to the outside world, and continuously expand the breadth and depth of China's modernization.

src: 要坚持独立自主、自立自强，坚持把国家和民族发展放在自己力量的基点上，坚持把我国发展进步的命运牢牢掌握在自己手中。
raw: We must insist on independence and self-reliance, insist on putting the development of the country and the nation in the starting point of our own strength, and insist on firmly holding the destiny of the development and progress of our country in our own hands.

src: 要不断扩大高水平对外开放，深度参与全球产业分工和合作，用好国内国际两种资源，拓展中国式现代化的发展空间，在互利共赢中共享发展机遇、共创美好未来。
raw: We should continuously expand high-level opening-up to the outside world, participate deeply in the global industrial division of labor and cooperation, make good use of both domestic and international resources, expand the development space of Chinese modernization, and share development opportunities and create a better future in mutual benefit and win-win cooperation.

src: 循道而行，方能致远。
raw: To go far, one must go alone.

src: 让我们在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下、在习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想科学指引下，把握规律、笃行不怠，充分发挥积极性、主动性、创造性，正确处理好一系列重大关系，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家新征程上奋发有为，不断开辟中国式现代化新境界。
raw: Let us, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core, and with the scientific guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics in the New Era, grasp the laws, work hard and spare no efforts, and correctly handle a series of major issues. We should fully exert our positive energy, proactiveness and creativity, and strive to make progress in the new journey of building a modern socialist country in all-round development, and continuously open up new horizons for the Chinese-style modernization.

src: 同抗中共 美日菲达成防卫共识
raw: The United States, Japan, and the Philippines have reached a consensus on defense against the CCP

src: 亚洲 – 2月9日，菲律宾总统小马科斯（Bongbong Marcos）造访日本，与首相岸田文雄会谈。
raw: On February 9, Philippine President Bongbong Marcos visited Japan and met with Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.

src: 双方就反对中共侵犯南海与东海达成共识，菲日领导人在会后发布共同声明表示，将通过和美国签署三边防卫协议，进行实质防务交流，反对中共霸权政策。
raw: Both sides reached consensus on opposing the CCP's infringement on the South China Sea and the East China Sea. The leaders of the Philippines and Japan issued a joint statement after the meeting, saying that they would sign a trilateral defense agreement with the United States and conduct substantive defense exchanges to oppose the CCP's hegemonic policy.

src: 根据日本媒体的说法，岸田文雄希望藉这次会晤帮助日菲两国建立针对台海危机的政策。
raw: According to Japanese media, Kishida wanted to help Japan and the Philippines establish policies for the Taiwan Strait crisis during this meeting.

src: 小马科斯今年1月初曾访华，并且获得价值200亿美元的协议。
raw: In early January, Xiaomi visited China and signed a $20 billion agreement.

src: 但在这之后，中菲关系不仅没好转，反倒下滑。
raw: But after that, the relations between China and the Philippines not only did not improve, but rather deteriorated.

src: 本月初，菲律宾与美国签署协议，同意对美军开放更多基地，保障南海安全。
raw: Earlier this month, the Philippines signed an agreement with the United States to open more bases to the US military to ensure security in the South China Sea.

src: 新增加的一个基地距离台湾300公里，也是最接近中国的一个地点。
raw: The new base, located 300 kilometers from Taiwan, is the closest location to China.

src: 如果台湾出现危机，美军可能会在菲律宾的基地发动行动。
raw: If a crisis occurs in Taiwan, the US military may launch an operation from the base in the Philippines.

src: 日本媒体认为，现在日韩台澳乃至菲律宾都与美国形成轴心，构建西太平洋的“对抗中共弧线”，以推动地区合作。
raw: The Japanese media believes that Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Australia and the Philippines have formed an axis with the United States, and have built an "anti-CCP arc" in the Western Pacific to promote regional cooperation.

src: 中国鼓励拉高生育率 到高校催捐精 质量高标准
raw: China encourages higher birth rate by donating sperm to university

src: 中国云南省人类精子库9日发出宣传，征求大专以上学历者或在校生捐精，成功捐赠8至12次可获人民币4500元补贴。
raw: The Human Sperm Bank in Yunnan Province, China, issued a publicity on the 9th, inviting people with a college education or students to donate sperm, and those who donate 8 to 12 times can get a subsidy of 4,500 yuan.

src: 据台媒今天报道称，该讯息当日冲上微博热搜，并引发浙江、陕西、湖北、山东与北京等许多省市跟进倡议。
raw: According to Taiwanese media reports today, the message went viral on Weibo on the same day, and triggered the follow-up initiatives of many provinces and cities, including Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Hubei, Shandong and Beijing.

src: 据自由时报署名报道称，中国鼓励大学生捐精。
raw: According to a report by the Free Times, China encourages university students to donate sperm.

src: 各地高校捐精其中北京捐精门槛最高，除学历外，也要求身高170公分以上、五官端正、无明显脱发、近视度数不能高于600度。
raw: The universities in different regions donate sperm. The threshold for donating sperm in Beijing is the highest. In addition to academic qualifications, the donor must be taller than 170 cm, have a good appearance, no obvious hair loss, and the degree of myopia cannot be higher than 600 degrees.

src: 据该报道称，云南省人类精子库指出，捐精者可获得价值1000人民币的全套男科体检，“尤其精液与染色体检测，大部分人从未做过，对了解自己的生育状态意义重大”。
raw: According to the report, the sperm bank of Yunnan Province pointed out that the donor could get a full set of male reproductive health examination, which is worth 1000 yuan, “especially the examination of sperm and chromosome, which most people have never done before, and it is of great significance to know their reproductive status”.

src: 捐精者条件包括，身高165公分以上、大专及以上学历或在读，无色盲色弱、B肝等遗传疾病与传染病者。
raw: The conditions for sperm donors include a height of 165 cm or above, a college education or above, no color blindness, and no genetic diseases or infectious diseases.

src: 报道引述中国天目新闻消息指，陕西省人类精子库印有“有偿捐精，无限光荣”的宣传海报，呼吁年轻人响应捐精，并鼓励网友转发相关讯息，“让爱心传递”。
raw: According to the report, the Chinese Tianmu News quoted a publicity poster of the Sperm Bank of Shaanxi Province, which reads “Donate sperm for money, it is honorable”. It called on young people to donate sperm and encouraged netizens to forward the relevant messages “to let love spread”.

src: 陕西省价码高于云南，合格者每次可领取人民币300元现金，完成一定次数的捐精者可获得人民币5000元补贴。
raw: In Shaanxi Province, the price is higher than that in Yunnan. Qualified people can receive RMB 300 in cash each time, and those who complete a certain number of donations can receive RMB 5,000 subsidies.

src: 而目前已知价码最高的是北京，最高补贴5150人民币。
raw: The highest subsidy known at present is 5150 yuan, and it is in Beijing.

src: “基金E账户”来了：证监会授权开发 投资者名下所有基金实现归集和查询 - 经济观察网 － 专业财经新闻网站
raw: “Fund E account” has arrived: the CSRC authorized its development; all funds under the name of investors can be collected and queried - Economic Observation Network － a professional financial news website

src: 经济观察网 记者 陈姗 基金购买渠道繁杂导致账户信息归集不易？
raw: The reporter Chen Ming of Economic Observer Network thinks that the complicated channels of fund purchase lead to the difficulty of collecting account information.

src: 总是遗忘“小金库”？
raw: Always forgetting the “petty cash”?

src: 基民的这些问题即将得到解决。
raw: The problems of the Kims will soon be solved.

src: 2月10日，证监会公告称，“基金E账户”APP在各手机应用商店上架并开展公开试运行。
raw: On February 10, the CSRC announced that the “Fund E account” APP was available for download and open testing in various mobile application stores.

src: 据介绍，“基金E账户”为个人投资者提供公募基金账户及份额信息的“一站式”查询服务，旨在解决广大中小投资者遗忘账户、查询繁琐等行业服务痛点。
raw: According to the introduction, the "Fund E account" provides a "one-stop" query service for personal investors to query the account and share information of public fund, aiming to solve the pain points of the industry, such as forgetting the account and querying complicatedly.

src: 据Wind数据显示，截至2022年底，国内共有公募基金管理人156家，管理基金规模约26万亿元；公募基金份额登记机构167家，公募基金销售机构411家。
raw: According to Wind data, as of the end of 2022, there were 156 public fund managers in China, managing fund assets of about 26 trillion yuan; there were 167 public fund share registration institutions, and 411 public fund sales institutions.

src: 各份额登记机构账户体系相互独立，缺乏行业统一的查询渠道。
raw: The system of accounting of each shareholder registration institution is independent, and there is no unified query channel in the industry.

src: 有行业人士表示，2021年末我国基金投资者超过7.2亿人，也就是说，全国有一半人都投资了基金产品。
raw: According to industry insiders, at the end of 2021, China's fund investors exceeded 720 million, which means that half of the country's population invested in fund products.

src: 此前，投资者需要通过不同销售机构查询购买情况，而通过“基金E账户”可以查询所有销售渠道购买的情况，持有基金情况一目了然。
raw: Previously, investors needed to inquire about their purchase through different sales institutions. However, with the “Fund E account”, investors can inquire about all purchases made through all sales channels, and the holding of the fund is clear at a glance.

src: “基金E账户”APP是什么？
raw: "Fund E Account" is an app.

src: 据相关文件介绍，“基金E账户”APP 是中国结算经中国证监会批准开发建设的公募基金行业门户手机应用，可为投资者提供全市场公募基金产品场外份额持有情况的一站式查询。
raw: According to the relevant documents, the “Fund E Account” APP is a mobile application developed and constructed by China Securities for the public fund industry, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. It can provide investors with one-stop inquiry of off-exchange shareholding of all public fund products in the market.

src: 投资者可以通过“基金E账户”方便、快捷地掌握自己通过全市场各销售渠道购买的各基金管理人旗下公募基金产品场外份额的持有情况，全面提升查询效率。
raw: Investors can conveniently and quickly grasp the holdings of off-exchange shares of all public fund products under the management of all fund managers through the "Fund E Account", which can greatly improve the efficiency of inquiries.

src: 具体来说，投资者可以通过“基金E账户”查询到的信息包括：在全市场各公募基金管理人处开立的基金账户信息、在公募基金销售机构处开立的交易账户信息以及持有的包括公开募集证券投资基金以及证券公司设立管理的投资者人数不受200人限制的集合资产管理计划等产品的场外份额持有情况。
raw: Specifically, the information that investors can inquire through "Fund E Account" includes: fund account information opened at all public fund managers, transaction account information opened at public fund sales institutions, and the off-exchange shareholding of products including publicly offered securities investment funds and asset management plans established and managed by securities companies, with no limit on the number of investors.

src: 上海证券基金评价研究中心业务负责人刘亦千向经济观察网记者表示，投资者可以通过“基金E账户”App一站式获知其所有的场外公募基金持有情况，帮助其找回“被遗忘的资产”，更重要的是为客户实现了综合基金投资情况的全账户信息归集，帮助客户更及时、准确、完整的掌握自身投资情况，从而更好地优化自身的基金组合配置，更好地规划自身的财务安排。
raw: According to Liu Yicheng, the person in charge of the business of Shanghai Securities Fund Evaluation Research Center, investors can know the holdings of all their off-exchange public funds through the "Fund E Account" App, which helps them find "forgotten assets" and, more importantly, helps customers collect comprehensive information on their fund investment, which allows customers to grasp their investment situation more timely, accurate and complete, and thus better optimize their fund portfolio and plan their financial arrangements.

src: 如何注册使用？
raw:
To register and use it, follow these steps:

1. Go to the website of the app or software you want to use.
2. Look for a link or button that says "Download," "Get," or "Install."
3. Click on that link or button.
4. Follow the instructions on the screen to complete the registration process.

Note: The registration process may vary depending on the app or software you are using.

src: 记者注意到，目前，“基金E账户”APP已在华为、苹果、小米、OPPO、vivo等手机应用商店上架，但APP尚处于公开试运行阶段，注册需要填写邀请码，投资者可以联系所持有基金的基金管理人获取。
raw: Journalists noticed that the "Fund E Account" APP has been uploaded to the app stores of Huawei, Apple, Xiaomi, OPPO, and vivo, but the APP is still in the public trial operation stage. Investors need to fill in the invitation code to register, and investors can contact the fund management company they hold to get the invitation code.

src: 上海一家中大型公募基金客服人员向经济观察网记者提供了一个6位数的邀请码，并告诉记者，“APP试运行阶段，中国结算提供给每个基金管理人一定数量的邀请码，投资者电话过来获取，我们都会提供。
raw: A customer service person from a large Chinese public fund in Shanghai provided an invitation code with six digits to the reporter of Economic Observer, and told the reporter, “During the trial operation of the APP, China Clearing provides a certain number of invitation codes to each fund manager, and investors can get them by calling us.

src: 等试运行结束后，开放用户注册时就不用邀请码了。
raw: After the trial operation is over, the invitation code will not be needed when opening the user registration.

src: 记者根据证监会官网公示的“基金E账户”下载及使用说明相关文件进行了账户注册并完成查询，整个过程耗时仅几分钟，主要分为四步：用户注册、实名认证、基金账户绑定、公募基金查询。
raw: Journalists registered and completed the query of the "fund E account" according to the relevant documents disclosed by the CSRC on its official website. The whole process only took a few minutes and mainly consisted of four steps: user registration, real name authentication, bonding of the fund account, and public fund query.

src: 通过实名认证这一步之后，点击“资产”基金绑定按钮，记者通过各个基金销售平台购买的所有基金产品都呈现在绑定选项列表中（可绑定账户），完成绑定后就可以直观看到所投基金总资产并可以开始使用查询功能了。
raw: After the real name authentication, click the "Asset" fund binding button, and all the fund products purchased by the reporter through various fund sales platforms will be displayed in the binding option list (can bind account), and after binding, you can see the total assets of the fund you invested in and start using the query function.

src: 值得注意的是，“基金E账户”仅为投资者提供查询服务，并不能进行申赎买卖。
raw: It is worth noting that the “Fund E account” only provides inquiry services to investors and cannot be used for redemption and trading.

src: “基金 E 账户”所显示的数据日期一般为用户进行查询的日期（T日)往前推三个交易日。
raw: The data displayed in the "Fund E account" is generally the date three trading days before the date of the user's query (T day).

src: 比如，在2 月10日打开“基金E账户”，资产页所显示的总资产、基金份额、基金净值对应日期为该日期往前推三个交易日，即2月7日。
raw: For example, on February 10, when you open the "Fund E account", the total assets, fund shares, and net value of the fund corresponding to the date will be pushed back three trading days, that is, February 7.

src: 多项数据衰退 台湾经济开年表现不佳-中新网
raw: Many data decline, Taiwan's economy starts the year poorly - www.chinanews.com

src: 新华社台北2月11日电(记者赵博、黄扬)出口贸易额“连五黑”，制造业采购经理人指数(PMI)连续7个月紧缩，消费者物价指数(CPI)又见“3字头”……近期，台湾当局陆续发布2023年1月经济数据。
raw: Xinhua News Agency, Taipei, February 11 (reporters Zhao Bo, Huang Yanyan) Export trade volume “five consecutive black”, manufacturing purchasing managers index (PMI) contracted for 7 consecutive months, consumer price index (CPI) saw “three-headed”…… Recently, the Taiwan authorities have released the economic data of January 2023 one after another.

src: 专家分析认为，台湾经济开年表现欠佳，增长压力不小。
raw: Experts analyzed that Taiwan's economy started the year poorly and the growth pressure is not small.

src: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
raw: According to the Taiwan authorities’ department in charge of financial affairs, the region’s exports amounted to US$31.51 billion in January this year, a year-on-year decrease of 21.2%, and the fifth consecutive month of negative growth.

src: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
raw: Exports of 11 major export commodities fell year on year.

src: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
raw: The plastic rubber and its products and optical instruments fell the most, with a year-on-year decrease of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

src: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
raw: The export of electronic components decreased by 20.1% year on year, creating the largest decline in 11 years.

src: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
raw: Among them, the annual decline of integrated circuits was 18.3%, creating the largest decline in 14 years.

src: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
raw: The head of statistics of the department, Cai Meina, said that this showed the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry and the adjustment of the electronics industry.

src: 统计显示，1月台湾地区进出口双降，出超金额仅23.4亿美元，创近3年来最低水平。
raw: Statistics show that in January, both imports and exports of Taiwan region fell, and the excess amount of exports was only 2.34 billion US dollars, which is the lowest level in the past three years.

src: 台当局财政事务主管部门认为，全球终端需求减少，产业调整库存抑制厂商购料意愿，出口颓势短期难见改善，台湾今年首季出口衰退恐高于预期。
raw: The Financial Supervisory Service of the Taiwan authorities believes that the global terminal demand is reduced, and the adjustment of industrial inventory has inhibited the willingness of manufacturers to purchase raw materials. The export slump is unlikely to improve in the short term. The export decline of Taiwan in the first quarter of this year is expected to be worse than expected.

src: 据台湾中华经济研究院发布，今年1月台湾制造业采购经理人指数(PMI)经季节调整后为40.4%，较去年12月续跌3.3个百分点，连续7个月紧缩。
raw: According to the Taiwan China Economic Research Institute, the seasonally adjusted Taiwan Manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) in January was 40.4%, a decrease of 3.3 percentage points from December last year, and contracted for seven consecutive months.

src: 经济监测指标体系中，PMI以50%为荣枯线，指数大于50%，代表景气扩张，反之为紧缩。
raw: In the economic monitoring indicator system, the PMI is 50% as the demarcation line of prosperity and decline, and the index is greater than 50%, which represents prosperity expansion, and vice versa for contraction.

src: 1月台湾PMI五项组成指标中，新增订单、生产与人力雇佣紧缩，供应商交货时间下降，存货紧缩。
raw: In January, Taiwan PMI's five components were tight, with new orders, production and employment of labor tightening, and the delivery time of suppliers was shortened, and inventory was tight.

src: 六大产业全数回报PMI紧缩，各产业依紧缩速度排序为电力暨机械设备产业(35.1%)、电子暨光学产业(35.2%)、化学暨生技医疗产业(39.2%)、基础原物料产业(42.4%)、交通工具产业(42.6%)与食品暨纺织产业(45.7%)。
raw: All six industries have a contracted PMI, and the industries are ranked in order of the contraction speed, namely, the electrical and mechanical equipment industry (35.1%), the electronic and optical industry (35.2%), the chemical and biotechnology and medical industry (39.2%), the basic raw material industry (42.4%), the transportation equipment industry (42.6%), and the food and textile industry (45.7%).

src: 物价方面，台当局“主计总处”公布，今年1月台湾CPI年增率为3.04%，自去年7月以来再度冲破3%。
raw: In terms of prices, the “Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics” of the Taiwan authorities announced that the CPI of Taiwan in January this year was 3.04%, which exceeded 3% for the first time since July last year.

src: 其中，蔬菜价格飞涨28.25%，创17个月新高。
raw: Among them, the price of vegetables soared by 28.25%, creating a new high in 17 months.

src: 台“主计总处”专门委员曹志弘坦言，菜价涨幅确实超乎预期，排除春节因素，今年1月和2月平均CPI应接近去年12月的2.71%，通胀压力还是存在，且仍在高点。
raw: The special commissioner of the Taiwan “Directorate-General of Accounts” Cai Zhihong admitted that the increase in vegetable prices was beyond expectation, excluding the factor of the Chinese New Year, the average CPI in January and February of this year should be close to 2.71% in December of last year, and the inflation pressure still exists, and it is still at a high point.

src: 展望今年台湾经济，综合《联合报》、“Yahoo财经”等岛内媒体报道，专家表示悲观。
raw: Looking forward to this year's Taiwan economy, experts expressed pessimism after comprehensive reports by local media such as United Daily News and Yahoo Finance.

src: 台“中央大学”经济系教授吴大任分析，出口衰退可能造成出口制造业厂商现金流出现问题，债务违约风险上升。
raw: According to analysis by Wu Daoren, a professor at the “Central University” Economics Department, the decline in exports may cause problems with cash flow for export manufacturers, and the risk of debt default will increase.

src: 同时，订单减少导致厂商削减人力成本，影响劳动市场和家庭经济，反过来冲击消费能力。
raw: At the same time, the reduction of orders leads to the reduction of labor costs of manufacturers, which affects the labor market and the family economy, and in turn, it affects the consumption capacity.

src: 台湾经济研究院研究员邱达生认为，今年欧美通胀状况未解，需求持续萎缩，预估台湾出口衰退会延续到上半年。
raw: Chiu Dasheng, a researcher at the Taiwan Economic Research Institute, believes that the inflation situation in Europe and the United States has not been resolved, and the demand continues to shrink, and it is estimated that the decline in Taiwan's exports will continue into the first half of the year.

src: 由于台湾经济靠出口支撑，受出口低迷影响，全年经济增长表现将不如去年。
raw: Due to the fact that Taiwan's economy is supported by exports, and affected by the low exports, the economic growth performance of the whole year will be worse than that of last year.

src: 气球事件更擦亮美国眼睛？
raw: Does the balloon incident make America look better?

src: 加强限制技术出口到中国
raw: Strengthen restrictions on technology exports to China

src: 据华尔街日报今天报道称，气球事件后，美国准备进一步收紧对华技术出口。
raw: According to a report by the Wall Street Journal today, the United States is preparing to further tighten the export of technology to China after the balloon incident.

src: 现任和前任安全官员表示，上述气球事件突显了中国构成的国家安全威胁，并将为加强美国技术保护争取更多政治支持。
raw: Current and former security officials say the balloon incident underscores the national security threat posed by China and will help generate more political support for beefing up U.S. technology protections.

src: 美国称该气球携带了用于情报收集和通信的天线和传感器。
raw: The United States said that the balloon carried antennas and sensors for intelligence gathering and communication.

src: 据前美国中央情报局高级官员、现供职于华盛顿智库新美国安全中心的Martijn Rasser说。
raw: According to Martijn Rasser, a former senior official of the US Central Intelligence Agency and now serving at the New American Security Center in Washington.

src: “这无疑是火上浇油，支持了对华强硬派的观点”。
raw: "This is undoubtedly adding fuel to the fire and supports the hard-line view against China."

src: 白宫新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔(Karine Jean-Pierre)周四对记者表示，“我们还将考虑采取更大范围的行动，以揭露和应对中国更大规模的监视活动，这些活动对我们的国家安全以及我们的盟友和伙伴构成威胁。
raw: White House press secretary Karine Jean-Pierre said on Thursday that “we will also consider taking more extensive action to expose and respond to China’s larger-scale surveillance activities, which pose a threat to our national security and to our allies and partners.

src: ”美国官员说，他们已向30多个国家的政府通报了上述气球事件的情况，国际协调对于应对中国威胁至关重要。
raw: “US officials said they had informed the governments of more than 30 countries about the balloon incident, and international coordination is crucial to counter the Chinese threat. ”

src: 战略与国际问题研究中心的高级研究员Emily Benso说，除了拜登政府的行动外，美国众议院新成立的美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会也可能施压美国采取更严厉的措施来拖慢中国的发展。
raw: According to Emily Benso, a senior research fellow at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, in addition to the actions of the Biden administration, the newly established Select Committee on Strategic Competition between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party in the US House of Representatives may also put pressure on the United States to take more stringent measures to slow down China’s development.

src: 她说，国会议员将感受到越来越大的压力，要求他们采取更强硬的立场，而这又可能会迫使白宫采取更强硬的政策。
raw: She said that lawmakers would feel increasing pressure to take a tougher stance, which could push the White House to adopt a more aggressive policy.

src: 华尔街日报称，许多主张更严格出口管制的人也在推动扩大管制范围，将人工智能等行业纳入其中。
raw: The Wall Street Journal said that many people advocating for stricter export controls are also pushing to expand the scope of the controls to include industries such as artificial intelligence.

src: 美国政府也已经在制定一项对外投资审查计划，审视美国在海外的投资是否存在来自中国的潜在国家安全威胁。
raw: The U.S. government is also developing a foreign investment review plan to examine whether U.S. investments overseas pose potential national security threats from China.

src: 分析人士称，白宫可能会面临要求更快推出该计划的呼声。
raw: Analysts said the White House may face calls to move more quickly to implement the plan.

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品开售 最短可只持有360天-中新网
raw: First batch of personal pension products launched for sale, with the shortest holding period of only 360 days - chinanews.com

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品开售
raw: Personal pension wealth management products were launched for the first time.

src: 家机构的7只产品可选 最短可只持有360天
raw: 7 products of home appliances can be selected, and the shortest holding period is only 360 days.

src: 个人养老金理财产品终于上线了。
raw: The personal pension wealth product has finally been launched.

src: 2月10日，中国理财网发布首批个人养老金理财产品名单，工银理财、农银理财和中邮理财的7只个人养老金理财产品正式发售。
raw: On February 10, China Wealth Management Network released the first list of personal pension wealth management products, and 7 personal pension wealth management products of Guotai Asset Management, Rural Commercial Bank Asset Management and China Postal Savings Fund Management were officially launched.

src: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集齐个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
raw: At this point, the "shelves" of the personal pension account are finally full of four types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension investment, personal pension insurance, and publicly offered mutual funds.

src: 据介绍，首批个人养老金理财产品，全部为公募类净值型开放式产品，其中新发产品5只、存续产品2只，除1只产品为混合类产品外，其余6只产品均为固定收益类产品。
raw: It is introduced that the first batch of personal pension wealth management products are all publicly offered net value open-end products, including 5 newly issued products and 2 existing products, except for one product which is a mixed type product, the other 6 products are fixed income type products.

src: 北京青年报记者看到，5只新发产品中有4只来自工银理财，全部是固定收益类产品，最短持有期限分别为365天、540天、720天和1080天，对应的业绩比较基准(年化)分别为3.70 % - 4.20 % 、 4.10 % - 4.60 % 、 4.40 % - 4.90 % 、 5.25 % - 5.75 % 。
raw: The Beijing Youth Daily reporters found that 4 out of the 5 new products were from ICBC Wealth Management, all of which were fixed income products, and the shortest holding period was 365 days, 540 days, 720 days, and 1080 days, respectively, and the corresponding performance benchmarks (annualized) were 3.70% - 4.20%, 4.10% - 4.60%, 4.40% - 4.90%, and 5.25% - 5.75%.

src: 剩余一只新发产品是“邮银财富添颐·鸿锦最短持有1095 天 1 号 ” ， 也是固定收益类产品，2月10日开始募集，2月19日结束募集，风险等级为二级。
raw: The remaining new product is "Postal Savings Wealth Add Yi Heng Hongjing Shortest Holding Period 1095 Days 1 ", which is also a fixed income product. It started collecting on February 10 and ended on February 19. The risk level is level 2.

src: 两只存续产品中，一只是农银理财“农银同心·灵动”360天科技创新人民币理财产品，投资性质为混合类，风险等级为三级。
raw: One of the two existing products is Agricultural Bank of China Wealth Management “Agricultural Bank of China Unity·Spiritual” 360-day Science and Technology Innovation RMB Wealth Management Product, which is a mixed type investment product with a risk level of three.

src: 另一只存续产品是“邮银财富添颐·鸿锦最短持有365 天 1 号 ” ， 固定收益类型，去年12月30日开始募集，今年1月4日正式运作，2月8日的累计净值为1.0011。
raw: Another product that is still available is "Postal Savings Wealth Additional Yinhe Hongjin Minimum Holding Period 365 Days No. 1," a fixed income product. It started collecting funds on December 30 last year and officially started operating on January 4 this year. Its cumulative net value on February 8 was 1.0011.

src: 根据《国务院办公厅关于推动个人养老金发展的意见 》 ， 个人养老金资金账户资金可投资的金融产品包括银行理财、储蓄存款、商业养老保险、公募基金等。
raw: According to the "Opinions on Promoting the Development of Individual Pension Insurance" issued by the Office of the State Council, the financial products that the personal pension fund account funds can invest in include bank wealth management products, savings deposits, commercial pension insurance, publicly offered funds, etc.

src: 首批个人养老金理财产品发售，标志着个人养老金投资者可正式通过个人养老金资金账户购买理财产品。
raw: The first personal pension wealth management product was sold, marking that personal pension investors can officially purchase wealth management products through the personal pension fund account.

src: 去年11月银保监会制定了《商业银行和理财公司个人养老金业务管理暂行办法 》 。
raw: The China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission formulated the Interim Measures for the Management of Personal Pension Business of Commercial Banks and Wealth Management Companies in November last year.

src: 《办法》规定，参加人可以通过个人养老金资金账户购买个人养老储蓄、个人养老金理财产品、个人养老金保险产品、个人养老金公募基金产品等个人养老金产品。
raw: According to the Measures, participants may purchase personal pension products such as personal pension savings, personal pension investment products, personal pension insurance products, and publicly offered personal pension fund products through their personal pension fund accounts.

src: 随后，人社部、财政部、国家税务总局三部门发布通知，明确个人养老金制度在北京、天津，以及河北石家庄、雄安新区，山西晋城市等36个先行城市和地区启动实施。
raw: Subsequently, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Administration of Taxation issued a notice, which clearly stated that the individual pension system would be implemented in 36 pilot cities and regions, including Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei Shijiazhuang, as well as the Xiong’an New Area, and Jinci City, Shanxi.

src: 截至2022年底，个人养老金参加人数1954万人，缴费人数613万人，总缴费金额142亿元。
raw: As of the end of 2022, the number of participants in personal pensions was 19.54 million, and the number of contributors was 6.13 million, with a total contribution amount of 14.2 billion yuan.

src: 此前，参与试点的银行只上架了个人养老储蓄、个人养老金保险产品和个人养老金公募基金三类产品。
raw: Previously, banks participating in the pilot only offered three types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension insurance, and personal pension publicly offered funds.

src: 如今，个人养老金理财产品也聚齐之后，投资者该如何选择？
raw: Now that a variety of personal pension wealth management products have gathered together, how should investors choose?

src: 交银理财产品研发部专家表示，相比其他个人养老金产品，试点阶段的养老理财产品和个人养老金理财产品均具有三方面的特点。
raw: According to experts from the product development department of ICBC Credit, compared with other personal pension products, the pilot period of the pension wealth management products and personal pension wealth management products have three characteristics.

src: 一是稳健性，风险管理机制更加健全，投资策略和理念更为稳健，并实施非母行第三方独立托管。
raw: One is prudence, the risk management mechanism is more complete, the investment strategy and concept are more prudent, and the third-party independent custody is implemented.

src: 二是长期性，试点阶段养老理财产品的期限都在5年及以上，下一步发行的个人养老金理财产品，最短持有期原则上为1年，鼓励持有3年以上。
raw: Secondly, it is long-term. The term of the pilot period of the long-term care finance products is 5 years and above. In the next step, the holding period of the individual pension finance products will be 1 year as a principle, and it will be encouraged to hold for 3 years or more.

src: 三是普惠性，产品购买门槛低，起购点一般为1元，有的低至0.01元，产品的托管费、管理费等费率更加优惠。
raw: Third, it is inclusive. The threshold for purchasing products is low, and the starting point is generally 1 yuan, and some are as low as 0.01 yuan. The fees such as custody fees and management fees are more favorable.

src: 专业人士指出，投资者要根据产品特点和自己的风险承受能力进行选择。
raw: Professionals pointed out that investors should choose according to the characteristics of the product and their risk tolerance.

src: 个人养老金储蓄具有期限较长、利率较高、安全性高的特点，适合风险承受能力弱的人群；个人养老金保险产品重在保障，比较适合无法承担投资风险，可以接受稳定收益的人群；而个人养老金理财产品和公募基金产品不保本也不保收益，有一定投资风险，但预期收益较高，适合具备一定的金融知识、风险承担能力较高的人群。
raw: The personal pension savings have the characteristics of long-term, high interest rate and high safety, suitable for people with low risk tolerance; personal pension insurance products focus on protection, suitable for people who cannot bear investment risks and can accept stable returns; while personal pension investment products and publicly offered funds do not guarantee the principal or returns, have certain investment risks, but have high expected returns, suitable for people with certain financial knowledge and high risk tolerance.
