src: 新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班结业 - 滚动新闻 - 湖南日报网 - 华声在线
raw: The Seminar on Learning and Implementing the Thoughts of Xi Jinping on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics in the New Era and the Spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress for New Members, Alternate Members and Leading Officials of Provincial and Departmental Levels of the Central Committee was concluded.

src: 新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班结业
raw: The seminar for new members, alternate members and provincial and ministerial leading cadres of the Central Committee on studying and implementing the thoughts of Xi Jinping on socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era and the 20th CPC National Congress was concluded.
Feb 11, 2023 [Source: Xinhua News Agency] [Editor: Li Xifan]

src: 新华社北京2月10日电 新进中央委员会的委员、候补委员和省部级主要领导干部学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神研讨班10日下午在中央党校（国家行政学院）结业，中共中央政治局常委、中央书记处书记蔡奇出席结业式并作总结讲话。
raw: Xinhua News Agency Beijing February 10th Message - The seminar for the newly elected members, alternate members and leading cadres of the provincial and ministerial level on learning and implementing the thoughts of Xi Jinping on socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era and the 20th CPC National Congress was concluded in the Central Party School (National Administrative College) on the afternoon of the 10th. Cai Qi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, attended the conclusion ceremony and made a summary speech.

src: 他表示，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话精神，更加坚定拥护“两个确立”、坚决做到“两个维护”，增强本领、真抓实干，扎实推进中国式现代化各项工作，在全面建设社会主义现代化国家、全面推进中华民族伟大复兴中创造经得起历史、实践和人民检验的业绩。
raw: He said that we should deeply study and implement the important spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's speech at the opening ceremony of the seminar, more firmly embrace the "two establishments", resolutely do the "two safeguards", enhance our capabilities, and work hard to push forward all aspects of Chinese-style modernization, and create a performance that can stand the test of history, practice and people in the process of building a socialist modernized country in all respects and promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

src: 研讨班期间，全体学员以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，认真学习党的二十大精神和习近平总书记在研讨班开班式上的重要讲话，联系实际深入研讨交流，深化了对中国式现代化一系列重大理论和实践问题的认识，增强了在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下以中国式现代化全面推进中华民族伟大复兴的信心和决心，增强了履职尽责、做好工作、确保新时代新征程良好开局的责任感和使命感。
raw: During the seminar, all the students were guided by the thoughts of Xi Jinping on socialism with Chinese characteristics, and carefully studied the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress and the important speech of General Secretary Xi Jinping at the opening ceremony of the seminar. They conducted in-depth research and exchanges on a series of major theoretical and practical issues of Chinese-style modernization, deepened their understanding of these issues, and strengthened their confidence and determination in comprehensively promoting Chinese-style modernization under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping as the core, and their sense of responsibility and mission in fulfilling their duties and responsibilities, ensuring a good start for the new journey in the new era.

src: 结业式上，研讨班10名代表发言，汇报交流了学习收获。
raw: At the graduation ceremony, 10 representatives of the seminar made speeches to report and share their learning achievements.

src: 蔡奇表示，学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想和党的二十大精神，既是当前和今后一个时期的首要政治任务，也是一项长期战略任务，要按照“全面学习、全面把握、全面落实”的要求，推动学习贯彻工作不断往深里走、往实里走、往心里走。
raw: Cai Qi said that learning and implementing the thoughts of Xi Jinping on socialism with Chinese characteristics in the new era and the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress is both the primary political task of the present and the future, and a long-term strategic task. It is necessary to promote learning and implementation in-depth, thorough and sincere, in accordance with the requirements of "comprehensive learning, comprehensive understanding, and comprehensive implementation".

src: 要更加深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义，坚决维护习近平总书记的核心地位、维护党中央权威和集中统一领导，不断提高政治判断力、政治领悟力、政治执行力，始终在思想上政治上行动上同以习近平同志为核心的党中央保持高度一致。
raw: To understand more profoundly the decisive significance of the “two establishments”, to firmly safeguard the core position of General Secretary Xi Jinping, to safeguard the authority of the Party Central Committee and the centralized and unified leadership, to continuously improve political judgment, political understanding and political execution, and to always maintain high consistency with the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping as the core in thoughts, politics and actions.

src: 要努力掌握好马克思主义理论这一看家本领，自觉用党的创新理论武装头脑、指导实践、推动工作，在深学、细悟、笃行上下功夫，真正学出坚定信念、学出绝对忠诚、学出使命担当。
raw: We should strive to master the basic skills of Marxist theory, consciously use the innovative theory of the Party to arm our minds, guide our practice and promote our work, and work hard in deep study, profound understanding and sincere practice, so as to truly learn with firm belief, learn with absolute loyalty and learn with a sense of mission and responsibility.

src: 要以奋发有为的精神状态贯彻落实好党的二十大各项决策部署，扎实推进中国式现代化，撸起袖子加油干，扑下身子当好“施工队长”，一步一个脚印把蓝图变为现实。
raw: We must carry out the decisions and arrangements of the 20th CPC National Congress with a spirit of arduous struggle, solidly promote the modernization of China in our own way, work hard, roll up our sleeves, act as the "construction supervisor", and turn the blueprint into reality step by step.

src: 要牢记全面从严治党永远在路上、党的自我革命永远在路上，压紧压实全面从严治党政治责任，以党的政治建设为统领，深入推进新时代党的建设新的伟大工程。
raw: We must remember that comprehensive strict Party discipline is a never-ending journey, and the self-revolution of the Party is a never-ending journey. We must bear the political responsibility of comprehensive strict Party discipline, and focus on the political construction of the Party, and deepen the new great cause of building the Party in the new era.

src: 要增强推动高质量发展本领、服务群众本领、防范化解风险本领，大兴调查研究之风，坚决防止和克服形式主义、官僚主义。
raw: To strengthen the ability to drive high-quality development, serve the people, and prevent and resolve risks, we should vigorously develop the spirit of investigation and research, and resolutely prevent and overcome formalism and bureaucratism.

src: 石泰峰、李干杰、李书磊、陈文清、刘金国、王小洪出席结业式，陈希主持结业式。
raw: Xi Jinping, Li Keqiang, Li Shiwei, Chen Wenquing, Liu Jinkun, Wang Xiaohong attended the graduation ceremony, and Chen Si presided over the ceremony.

src: 东德最后一位共产党总理今去世
raw: Last East German communist chancellor dies

src: 东德共产党的继任者在该党在一份声明中报告，“昨晚，汉斯·莫德罗 (Hans Modrow) 离开了我们，享年 95 岁。
raw: The successor of the East German Communist Party reported in a statement that “Last night, Hans Modrow left us at the age of 95.

src: 因此，我们的党失去了一位重要领导人。
raw: Therefore, our party has lost an important leader.

src: 1989 年 11 月 13 日，在将东柏林和西柏林分开 28 年的柏林墙打开四天后，莫德罗曾表示他将帮助把东德变成一个民主国家。
raw: On November 13, 1989, four days after the opening of the Berlin Wall, which separated East Berlin and West Berlin for 28 years, Modrow said he would help turn East Germany into a democratic country.

src: 当时，由于东德各地的抗议者要求民主和自由，共产党领导人被迫下台。
raw: At that time, the communist leaders were forced to step down due to the protesters' demands for democracy and freedom in East Germany.

src: 戈尔巴乔夫 (Mikhail Gorbachev) 在苏联上台后曾要求在苏联主导的东欧也进行变革。
raw: After Gorbachev took over in the Soviet Union, he called for changes in the Soviet-dominated Eastern Europe.

src: 1990 年 3 月，莫德罗宣布德意志民主共和国 (GDR) 的第一次也是唯一一次自由选举。
raw: In March 1990, Modrow announced the first and only free election in the German Democratic Republic (GDR).

src: 选举结果导致他不再担任总理。
raw: The election results led to him no longer serving as Prime Minister.

src: 尽管莫德罗进行了改革，但反对者指责他试图推迟 1990 年 10 月发生的政治变革和统一。
raw: Despite Mordor's reforms, opponents accused him of trying to delay the political changes and reunification that took place in October 1990.

src: 他还因试图重塑而不是废除秘密警察而受到批评。
raw: He has also been criticized for attempting to reform rather than abolish the secret police.

src: 1993 年，莫德罗在 1989 年 5 月的市政选举中被判选举舞弊罪名成立，但并未入狱。
raw: In 1993, Mordell was found guilty of electoral fraud in the 1989 municipal elections, but did not go to jail.

src: 有称这些指控是出于政治动机。
raw: It is said that these accusations are politically motivated.

src: 1990 年至 1994 年，莫德罗继续在德国议会任职，并于 1999 年至 2004 年担任欧洲议会议员。
raw: From 1990 to 1994, Mödrath continued to serve in the German Parliament, and from 1999 to 2004, he served as a member of the European Parliament.

src: 莫德罗将自己视为一名改革者，并希望从内部改变共产党。
raw: Modero sees himself as a reformer and hopes to change the Communist Party from within.

src: 1999 年，他告诉路透社，他不希望旧东德回归，但表示应该承认东德的成就。
raw: In 1999, he told Reuters that he did not want the old East Germany to return, but said that the achievements of East Germany should be recognized.

src: 莫德罗于 1928 年出生在当时的德国小镇 Jasenitz（现为波兰的 Jasienica），并接受过机械师培训。
raw: Modrow was born in 1928 in the then German town of Jasenitz (now Jasienica in Poland), and was trained as a mechanic.

src: 第二次世界大战期间，他担任青年消防队排长，并在冲突快结束时成为纳粹民兵组织 Volkssturm 的一员，该组织征召 16 至 60 岁的男子参加最后的战争挣扎。
raw: During World War II, he served as a platoon leader in the youth fire brigade and, as the conflict drew to a close, became a member of the Nazi militia organization, the Volkssturm, which conscripted men aged 16 to 60 for the final struggle of the war.

src: 17 岁时，莫德罗被苏联军队俘虏，作为战俘被带到苏联，在那里他参加了反法西斯课程，并成为一名坚定的共产党员。
raw: When he was 17, Modrow was captured by the Soviet army and taken as a prisoner of war to the Soviet Union, where he took part in anti-fascist courses and became a staunch communist.

src: 1949 年，即东德成立的那一年，他回国后找到了一份机械师的工作，并继续学习社会科学和经济学，并获得了博士学位。
raw: In 1949, the year of the establishment of East Germany, he returned to his home country and found a job as a mechanic. He continued to study social sciences and economics and obtained a doctorate.

src: 莫德罗是自由德国青年运动的一名工作人员，几乎所有东德年轻人都加入了该运动，并在 1973 年至 1989 年期间通过执政的社会统一党 (SED) 晋升为德累斯顿地区党的主席。
raw: Modrow was a staff member of the Free German Youth movement, which almost all East German young people joined, and rose to become the chairman of the party in the Dresden region between 1973 and 1989 through the ruling Socialist Unity Party (SED).

src: 他还在东德任职议会超过 30 年。
raw: He also served in the East German parliament for more than 30 years.

src: 1990 年莫德罗成为东德事实上的领导人，担任最高国家职务。
raw: In 1990, Modrow became the de facto leader of East Germany and held the highest state office.

src: 越通社河内——越通社特派记者报道，越南政府总理范明政和夫妇对新加坡和文莱进行正式访问已圆满成功，并取得了全面、务实且具体的成果。
raw: Vietnamese Prime Minister Nguyen Tan Dung and his wife have successfully completed their official visits to Singapore and Brunei, achieving comprehensive, practical and specific outcomes, VNA reported.

src: 在出访新加坡和文莱的三天之内，范明政总理共参加了30多项不同的活动。
raw: In the three days of his visit to Singapore and Brunei, Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng participated in more than 30 different activities.

src: 所取得的成效为促进越新两国战略伙伴关系和越文全面伙伴关系不断朝着更深、更广和有效的方向发展注入了新的动力。
raw: The achievements have injected new impetus to the development of the strategic partnership and comprehensive partnership between Vietnam and Laos in a deeper, broader and effective direction.

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理继续重申越南党和国家的对外路线，即独立自主，多元化，多变化，愿做所有国家的好朋友和可靠伙伴，以及国际社会的负责任成员。
raw: During the visit to the two countries, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh continued to reiterate the foreign policy line of the Party and the State of Vietnam, namely independence, diversity, and variability, and the willingness to be a good friend and reliable partner of all countries, as well as a responsible member of the international community.

src: 加强与新加坡和文莱的关系是各自国家的需求，致力于增进各自国家人民的福祉，致力于地区和世界的和平、稳定和发展。
raw: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is the need of their respective countries, and they are committed to promoting the well-being of their people and to peace, stability and development in the region and the world.

src: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
raw: At the meetings and talks, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh agreed with the leaders of Singapore and Brunei to continuously strengthen political trust with Vietnam through the exchange of high-level delegations, effective operation of bilateral cooperation mechanisms and important cooperation agreements, etc.

src: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
raw: Many cooperation documents were signed during this visit.

src: 其中，与新加坡签署的《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》和与文莱签署的《2023-2027年阶段加强越文全面伙伴关系的行动计划》是两大亮点。
raw: Among them, the Memorandum of Understanding on Green and Digital Economic Partnership with Singapore and the Action Plan for Strengthening Comprehensive Partnership with Brunei in the period of 2023-2027 are two highlights.

src: 越南与新加坡签署《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》。
raw: Vietnam and Singapore signed a Memorandum of Understanding on Green and Digital Economy Partnership.

src: 图自越通社
raw: Image from Vietnam News Agency

src: 在会见企业领导，座谈会或出席经济论坛期间，范明政总理强调越南欢迎并为新加坡和文莱企业在越南的数字化转型、绿色能源、高科技、创新创意等领域扩大投资范围创造便利条件。
raw: During the meeting with business leaders, the symposium or the attendance of the economic forum, Prime Minister Pham Minh Mẫn emphasized that Vietnam welcomed and created favorable conditions for Singaporean and Bruneian enterprises to expand investment in digital transformation, green energy, high technology, innovation and creativity in Vietnam.

src: 此次访问不仅有助于深化越南与新加坡和文莱在政治、外交、经济、安全、国防、教育培训、油气、旅游、民间交流等各个传统领域上的合作关系，而且还为各国在数字经济、绿色经济、能源转型、创新创意、智慧城市、可持续发展等新的潜在领域创造合作框架。
raw: This visit will not only help deepen the cooperation between Vietnam, Singapore and Brunei in various traditional fields such as politics, foreign affairs, economy, security, national defense, education and training, oil and gas, tourism, and people-to-people exchanges, but also create a cooperation framework for the two countries in new potential fields such as digital economy, green economy, energy transformation, innovation and creativity, smart city, and sustainable development.

src: 文莱国王哈桑纳尔博尔基亚与范明政总理准备进入双边座谈会。
raw: The King of Brunei Hassanal Bolkiah and Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng are ready to enter the bilateral talks.

src: 图自越通社
raw: Image from Vietnam News Agency

src: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理都安排时间走访和聆听旅居当地越南人社群的心思和愿望。
raw: During the visit to the two countries, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh arranged time to visit and listen to the thoughts and wishes of the Vietnamese community living in the localities.

src: 在两国领导人会见中，范明政总理都建议两国当局多关注，并为当地越南人社群得到公平的对待，有机会为当地社会贡献力量并培育两国关系等创造有利条件。
raw: During the meeting between the leaders of the two countries, Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh suggested that the two countries' authorities should pay more attention to and ensure fair treatment for local Vietnamese communities, create favorable conditions for contributing to local society and cultivating the relationship between the two countries.

src: 该建议都得到了两国领导人的同意和支持。
raw: Both leaders agreed and supported the proposal.

src: 特别的是，范明政总理还与两国领导人分享有关一个团结、和平、稳定和繁荣的东盟共同体的渴望；一致同意将与东盟国家保持团结协作并提升东盟在地区和国际形势复杂多变背景下的中心作用。
raw: Specifically, Prime Minister Fan Mingjian shared the leaders' aspiration for a united, peaceful, stable and prosperous ASEAN community; and agreed to maintain unity and coordination with ASEAN countries and enhance the central role of ASEAN in the complex and changing regional and international situations.

src: 凭借所取得的重要成果，范明政总理对新加坡和文莱的正式访问之旅为有效落实越共十三大以加强与东盟邻国的关系为优先的对外路线，有效实施越共中央政治局关于新形势下越南侨务工作的第12号结论（12-KL/TW ），并发挥全民族团结力量等作出积极贡献。
raw: Prime Minister Phan Minh Giang's official visit to Singapore and Brunei brought positive contributions to the effective implementation of the 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam, the priority of the foreign policy of Vietnam to strengthen relations with ASEAN neighboring countries, the effective implementation of the 12th conclusion of the Politburo of the Communist Party of Vietnam on the Vietnamese Overseas Community Work in the New Situation (12-KL/TW), and the mobilization of national unity.
(Finish)

src: NEWS GOV-MO: 警情通告：司警局呼吁市民提防假冒电讯公司诈骗短讯
raw: NEWS GOV-MO: Police News Release: Police Department Warns of Scam Texts from Fake Telecommunications Companies

src: 近日司警局接获多宗电信诈骗案，不法分子假冒本澳电讯公司向事主发送附有网站连结的诈骗短信，以积分到期须尽快换领奖赏为饵，诱骗事主登入虚假网站进行兑换。
raw: Recently, the Police have received a number of cases of telecommunication fraud. The fraudsters pretended to be the Hong Kong Telecommunications Company and sent the victim a fraudulent text message with a website link. They lured the victim to enter a fake website to redeem the reward, which was due to expire.

src: 事主按指示输入信用卡资料及验证码，随即收到金融机构通知信用卡出现不明消费记录，怀疑信用卡资料经上述网站被盗取。
raw: The victim followed the instructions to enter the credit card information and verification code, and then received a notification from the financial institution that there were unidentified records of consumption on the credit card. The victim suspected that the credit card information had been stolen from the above website.

src: 经查，证实相关电讯公司并无发出上述短讯。
raw: After investigation, it was confirmed that the relevant telecommunications company did not send the above short message.

src: 司警局呼吁市民，如接获类似手机短讯须提高警惕，切勿登入短讯所载网站连结或提供任何个人资料；若被要求提供信用卡资料、帐户交易密码、交易验证码，更要加倍谨慎，防止信用卡被盗刷。
raw: The police urge the public to be vigilant when receiving similar text messages and not to click on the links in the text messages or provide any personal information. If you are asked to provide credit card information, account transaction passwords or transaction verification codes, you should be doubly cautious to prevent credit card theft.

src: 防骗提示：
raw: Scam alert:

src: 1. 多关注网络安全资讯，提高个人防范意识；
raw: 1. Pay more attention to cybersecurity information and improve personal prevention awareness.

src: 2. 切勿随便登入来历不明的网站并在网站内登记个人及信用卡资料，以防遭人盗用；
raw: 2. Do not log in to unknown websites and register personal and credit card information on the website, so as not to be misused.

src: 3. 警惕假冒网站及钓鱼网站，时刻留意网站网址是否与官方网站完全相符；
raw: 3. Beware of fake websites and phishing websites, and always pay attention to whether the website address is completely consistent with the official website.

src: 4. 为手机、移动装置或电脑安装防毒软件，并定期更新；
raw: 4. Install antivirus software on your mobile phone, mobile device or computer and update it regularly.

src: 5. 怀疑遇到诈骗或其他犯罪时，应立即致电司警局防诈骗查询热线8800 7777或报案热线993求助。
raw: 5. If you suspect fraud or other crimes, you should call the Police Fraud Investigation Hotline 8800 7777 or the Crime Report Hotline 993 for help.

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争论，欧盟官员：接收过程步步瓶颈-中新网
raw: EU summit struggles with refugee policy, EU officials: every step of the reception process is a bottleneck - chinanews.com

src: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争吵不休，欧盟官员：接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈
raw: EU summit is in a dilemma over the refugee policy, and EU officials said that every step of the reception process has bottlenecks

src: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者 牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
raw: According to a report by Agence France-Presse on February 10, at the latest EU summit on that day, the President of the European Commission, von der Leyen, said that the leaders of the European Union agreed to introduce stricter policies on illegal immigrants, so that it would be easier to expel illegal immigrants.

src: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
raw: The EU's move is reportedly in response to growing concerns about illegal immigration in Europe. Nowadays, the core problem of the EU is that the number of illegal immigrants who can be repatriated is very small.

src: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
raw: According to the summit document, EU leaders called on the Commission to "immediately mobilize a large amount of EU funds" to strengthen external borders with infrastructure and surveillance.

src: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
raw: However, the EU and its member states have been arguing over issues such as the payment of the fence.

src: 冯德莱恩一再表示，欧盟资金不会支付相关费用。
raw: Merkel has repeatedly said that EU funds will not pay for the costs.

src: 但一些成员国的外交官员称，如果欧盟能分担外部边界沿线安装摄像头、瞭望塔和其他基础设施的部分，这将给各国腾出国家预算从而加快建设进程。
raw: But some member state diplomats said that if the EU could share the cost of installing cameras, watchtowers and other infrastructure along its external borders, it would free up national budgets and speed up the construction process.

src: 欧洲Euractiv网站称，欧盟官员承认，难民接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈，有限的接收能力和成员国不堪重负的移民当局无法阻止难民在欧盟各国提交“无数”庇护申请，欧盟的难民接收系统处于近乎“永久性的危机”中。
raw: The European Euractiv website said that EU officials admitted that every step of the refugee reception process was a bottleneck, and the limited reception capacity and the overburdened immigration authorities of member countries could not stop refugees from submitting "countless" asylum applications in EU countries, and the refugee reception system of the EU was in a "permanent crisis" near.

src: 据欧盟委员会估计，欧盟的申根国家去年收到超92万份庇护申请，比前一年增加近半。
raw: The European Commission estimated that the Schengen countries in the EU received more than 92,000 asylum applications last year, an increase of nearly half compared to the previous year.

src: 与此同时，欧盟去年记录到超 33万次非法入境。
raw: Meanwhile, the EU recorded more than 330,000 illegal border crossings last year.

src: 在该背景下，此次峰会还就一项“原则”达成协议，即欧盟国家可根据另一个成员国的法院判决将非法移民遣返回国。
raw: In this context, the summit also agreed on a "principle" that EU countries could deport illegal immigrants back to their home countries based on a court decision of another member country.

src: 此外，报道称，欧盟领导人还同意“增加对安全国家概念的使用”，这将为欧盟制定共同清单开辟道路。
raw: In addition, the report said that EU leaders also agreed to "increase the use of the concept of safe countries", which will pave the way for the EU to establish a common list.

src: (来源：环球时报 作者：牛瑞飞)
raw: (Source: The Global Times, Author: Ni Ruifeng)

src: 国民党副主席夏立言访中传达宋涛语：九二共识下欢迎绿营访陆
raw: The Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, Xia Lijiang, visited China to convey the message of Song Tao: welcome the Green Party to visit China under the consensus of 92.

src: 台湾中国国民党副主席夏立言今次访中先后会见中国国台办主任宋涛与中共中央政治局常委王沪宁。
raw: The Vice Chairman of the Chinese Nationalist Party in Taiwan, Shih Lien-jang, met with the Director of the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council, Song Tao, and the member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, Wang Meng.

src: 国民党官方机构国政基金会资深顾问赵春山昨天晚上接受台湾中央社采访，积极评价宋涛对夏立言所说，只要认同“九二共识”与反台独，中国欢迎绿营人士到访大陆。
raw: Zhao Chunshan, a senior advisor of the Nationalist Party’s official institution, the Guoguang Foundation, was interviewed by the Central News Agency of Taiwan yesterday evening. He actively praised Song Taizheng for his words to Xia Litian, saying that China welcomes Green Party people to visit the mainland as long as they acknowledge the “92 Consensus” and are against Taiwan independence.

src: 国民党方面评价认为是新鲜事物。
raw: The Nationalist Party considered it a new thing.

src: 夏立言稍早会见宋涛当日新闻没有提及此说法。
raw: Xia Litian met with Song Tao earlier in the day, and the news did not mention this statement.

src: 台湾执政的民进党连日澄清拒绝接受“九二共识”。
raw: The DPP, which governs Taiwan, has been clarifying its rejection of the “92 consensus” for several days.

src: 据中央社今天称，国民党副主席夏立言率团访陆，在北京期间，分别会见中共中央政治局常委王沪宁、新任国台办主任宋涛，与北京市委书记尹力。
raw: According to Central News Agency today, the delegation led by the Vice Chairman of the Kuomintang, Shali Lian, visited the mainland. During their stay in Beijing, they met with the member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Wang Meng, the new Director of the Taiwan Affairs Office, Song Tao, and the Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee, Yin Li.

src: 夏立言与宋涛会面谈到国共的政治基础是“九二共识”与反台独，国民党国政基金会资深顾问赵春山则在会中表示，国民党的“九二共识”是原汁原味的“九二共识”。
raw: Xia Litian and Song Tao talked about the political basis of the national government and the anti-Taiwan independence, and Zhao Chunshan, senior advisor of the National Party’s National Government Fund, said in the meeting that the National Party’s “nine-two consensus” is the original “nine-two consensus”.

src: 赵春山分析，这与前几次参与的会议感受不同。
raw: Zhao Chunshan analyzed that this was different from the previous meetings in which he participated.

src: 近期与大陆学界视讯座谈，以及这次的座谈，没有听到涉台学者讲武统与“反分裂法”，取而代之的是恢复交流与对话。
raw: Recently, I had a video conference with scholars from the mainland, and in this conference, I did not hear any words about the suppression of Taiwan and the “anti-secession law”. Instead, the focus was on the resumption of exchanges and dialogue.

src: 赵春山指出，两岸兵凶战危，中国大陆盼能透过国民党转达改善关系的意向。
raw: Zhao Chunshan pointed out that the two sides were in a dangerous situation, and the mainland of China hoped to convey its intention to improve relations through the Kuomintang.

src: 因为民共之间没有互信，对方仍愿做好对台湾人工作，代表不希望两岸关系搞坏。
raw: Because there is no mutual trust between the CPC and the DPP, the other party still wants to do a good job for the people of Taiwan, and the representative does not want to ruin the relationship between the two sides.

src: 据赵春山也说，王沪宁也亲自下指示向宋涛讲“他们（台湾农渔民）提的要求，你们一定要落实”，若无法通盘解决，也要采个案处理。
raw: According to Zhao Chunshan, Wang Hongwen also personally gave instructions to Song Tao to tell "you must implement the requests made by them (Taiwanese farmers and fishermen)" and if it is not possible to solve it comprehensively, it should be handled on a case-by-case basis.

src: 该报道没有提及国民党人访大陆是否当面提及中国军机军舰每日扰台，台湾少数县市的农渔问题，以及中央社记者采访是否提问此类问题。
raw: The report did not mention whether the KMT people mentioned the daily harassment of Chinese military aircraft and warships when visiting the mainland, the agricultural and fishery problems in a few counties and cities in Taiwan, and whether the reporter of Central Daily asked such questions.

src: 阿拉斯加上空被击落的 “物体”究竟是什么？
raw: The "object" that was shot down over Alaska was likely a balloon.

src: 扑朔迷离，猜测纷纷
raw: Confused and full of guesses.

src: 美国军方周五（2月10日）下午再次动用美国最先进的隐身喷气战机F-22击落了一个在美国阿拉斯加上空飞行的尚未确定身份的物体。
raw: The US military used the most advanced stealth fighter jet F-22 to shoot down an unidentified object flying in the sky of Alaska, USA, on Friday afternoon (February 10th).

src: 击落的地点距离阿拉斯加海岸十英里。
raw: The crash site is ten miles from the coast of Alaska.

src: 这是美军在不到一周的时间里第二次击落空中飞行物体。
raw: This is the second time in less than a week that the US military has shot down an airborne object.

src: 上周六，来自中国的一个间谍气球在美国领空上漂移数日后在美国南卡罗莱纳州沿岸附近上空被击毁。
raw: Last Saturday, a Chinese spy balloon was destroyed in the airspace of the United States near the coast of South Carolina in the United States after drifting for several days.

src: 五角大楼说，第二个被击落的物体于周四晚上首次进入美国领空，在阿拉斯加东北部上空移动时被美国军方跟踪，飞行高度为1.2万米（4万英尺），其大小与一辆小型汽车差不多，与先前被击落的那个中国间谍气球相比要小很多。
raw: The Pentagon said the second object shot down entered US airspace over the north-east of Alaska on Thursday night and was tracked by the US military as it moved at an altitude of 12,000 metres (40,000 feet), about the size of a small car, much smaller than the previous Chinese spy balloon.

src: 五角大楼还认为，目前没有迹象显示，这个物体是可操纵的。
raw: The Pentagon also believes that there is no evidence that the object is maneuverable.

src: 白宫国家安全委员会战略沟通协调员约翰·科比周五表示，虽然这个在高空飞行的物体的具体样子尚不清楚，但它“对民航飞机的安全构成了合理的威胁”。
raw: The White House's National Security Council's strategic communications coordinator, John Coy, said on Friday that although the specific appearance of the flying object in the sky was unclear, it "posed a reasonable threat to the safety of civil aviation."

src: 科比表示，这个物体与美国境内发现的那个间谍气球不同，它上面没有悬挂“有效载荷”。
raw: Kobe said that the object was different from the spy balloon found in the United States, which did not have a "payload" hanging from it.

src: 科比说，“我们把它称为一个‘物体’是我们目前能够作出的最好的描述”。
raw: Kobe said, "We call it an 'object' because it's the best description we can give it at this point."

src: 拜登总统在下令击落这个物体之前听取了五角大楼的建议，他作出这个决定的时候“非常谨慎”，科比补充说。
raw: Biden, who took advice from the Pentagon before ordering the strike, made the decision "very carefully," Cooke added.

src: 美国官方对这个物体的描述大致可以归纳为：大小相当于一辆小汽车，没有操纵杆，没有悬挂装置，飞行高度为一万米左右。
raw: The official description of the object by the United States can be roughly summarized as: the size is equivalent to that of a small car, it has no joystick and no suspension device, and the flight altitude is about 10,000 meters.

src: 但这些信息还无法回答基本问题，比如这个物体究竟是什么东西，它属于哪个国家，它在执行什么任务。
raw: But this information still does not answer the basic questions, such as what the object is, which country it belongs to, and what mission it is carrying out.

src: 目前网上许多的分析和猜测认为，这可能又是一只中国气球。
raw: Many analyses and guesses on the internet suggest that it might be another Chinese balloon.

src: 它可能与入侵美国领空的那只间谍气球和在拉美上空飘动的那只中国气球一样都来自中国，它们在不同地点执行某种任务。
raw: It may be the same as the spy balloon that invaded the US airspace and the Chinese balloon that floated in the air in Latin America, and they are all from China, and they are performing some tasks in different places.

src: 也有人把阿拉斯加的这个“物体”与“不明飞行物”（UFO）联系在一起。
raw: Some people also linked the Alaska "object" to "UFO" (Unidentified Flying Object).

src: 美国新闻周刊的报道引用美国前众议员彼得·梅杰（Peter Meijer）周五在推特上发出的推文说，“真希望这个‘不明飞行物’也是一个间谍气球，而不是一个合法的UFO”。
raw: The report by the US Newsweek quoted a tweet posted by Peter Meijer, a former US Congressman, on Friday, saying, "I really hope that this 'unidentified flying object' is a spy balloon, rather than a legitimate UFO."

src: “将外星飞船与气象气球混为一谈的讽刺意味很令人惊讶，但这不值得引发一场星际冲突，”梅杰说。
raw: "It is surprising that the ridiculous comparison of alien spacecrafts with weather balloons could cause an interstellar conflict," said Mayer.

src: 梅杰是在科比证实阿拉斯加的这个物体被击落之后不久发出这个推文的。
raw: Mejia tweeted this shortly after Kobe confirmed that the object in Alaska had been shot down.

src: 新闻周刊说，怀疑这个物体是UFO的不止是梅杰一人。
raw: According to the news magazine, it is not just Mayer who is suspicious of the object being a UFO.

src: 田纳西共和党籍众议员蒂姆·伯切特（Tim Burchett）批评政府上个月的掩盖情报的做法，要求国家情报总监办公室 (DNI)公布有关“不明飞行物”的报告。
raw: Tennessee Republican Congressman Tim Burchett criticized the government's cover-up of intelligence last month, and demanded the National Intelligence Directorate (DNI) to publish a report on "unidentified flying objects".

Feb 11, 2023 [Source: Xinhua News Agency] [Editor: Li Xifan]

src: 新华社北京2月10日电 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平2月9日给第19批援助中非共和国的中国医疗队队员回信，向他们以及广大援外医疗队员致以问候并提出殷切期望。
raw: Xinhua News Agency Beijing February 10th Message From Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People’s Republic of China, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, to the 19th Chinese Medical Team Aiding the Central African Republic, February 9th, 2021, Sends a Message to Them and All the Overseas Medical Aid Teams, and Expresses His Sincere Wishes.

src: 习近平在回信中说，你们在中非克服工作生活上的困难，用心服务当地民众，既是救死扶伤的白衣天使，也是传递情谊的友好使者。
raw: In his reply, Xi Jinping said that you are white angels who save lives and heal wounds and friendly messengers who spread love, and you have overcome difficulties in work and life in China-Africa and served the local people with heart.

src: 今年是中国援外医疗队派遣60周年，谨向正在和曾经执行援外医疗任务的同志们致以诚挚的慰问。
raw: This year is the 60th anniversary of the dispatch of Chinese medical aid teams abroad. We would like to express our sincere condolences to those who are currently and have been carrying out medical aid missions abroad.

src: 习近平指出，中国人民热爱和平、珍视生命，援外医疗就是生动的体现。
raw: Xi Jinping pointed out that the Chinese people love peace and cherish life, and the foreign medical assistance is a vivid demonstration of this.

src: 希望你们不忘初心、牢记使命，大力弘扬不畏艰苦、甘于奉献、救死扶伤、大爱无疆的中国医疗队精神，以仁心仁术造福当地人民，以实际行动讲好中国故事，为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体作出更大贡献。
raw: I hope that you will not forget your original intention and remember your mission, and vigorously carry forward the spirit of the Chinese medical team of not being afraid of hardship, being willing to make sacrifices, saving lives and treating injuries, and showing boundless love. Use your kindness and medical skills to benefit the local people, tell the Chinese story with practical actions, and make greater contributions to promoting the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind.

src: 援外医疗是我国援外工作的重要内容。
raw: Aid to foreign countries in the field of medicine is an important part of our country’s aid to foreign countries.

src: 1963年，我国向阿尔及利亚派出第一支援外医疗队。
raw: In 1963, China sent the first medical assistance team to Algeria.

src: 60年来，累计向非洲、亚洲、美洲、欧洲和大洋洲的76个国家和地区派遣医疗队员3万人次，诊治患者2.9亿人次，赢得国际社会广泛赞誉。
raw: Over the past 60 years, China has sent medical teams to 76 countries and regions in Africa, Asia, the Americas, Europe and Oceania, with a total of 30,000 medical staff, providing medical services to 290 million people, and won widespread praise from the international community.

src: 目前，援外医疗队在全球56个国家的115个医疗点工作，其中近一半在偏远艰苦地区。
raw: Currently, the medical team is working in 115 medical points in 56 countries around the world, and nearly half of them are in remote and difficult areas.

src: 近日，第19批援中非中国医疗队的11名队员给习近平总书记写信，汇报学习贯彻党的二十大精神、为当地民众提供医疗服务等情况，表达为推动构建人类卫生健康共同体贡献力量的决心。
raw: Recently, 11 members of the 19th batch of the Chinese medical team to Africa wrote a letter to Xi Jinping, reporting on studying and implementing the spirit of the 20th CPC National Congress, providing medical services to local residents, and expressing their determination to contribute to the construction of a community with a shared future for human health.

src: 伊朗纪念革命周年 支持抗议的黑客骇了总统电视讲话
raw: Iran marks revolution anniversary with hackers backing protests

src: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国周六举行官方集会纪念伊朗革命 44 周年，但反政府黑客短暂打断了总统易卜拉欣·莱西的电视讲话。
raw: Iran held an official gathering on Saturday to commemorate the 44th anniversary of the Iranian Revolution, but anti-government hackers briefly interrupted President Ebrahim Raisi's televised speech.

src: 总统的电视直播讲话在互联网上被中断了大约一分钟，屏幕上出现了一群反伊朗政府黑客的标志，他们的名字是“Edalat Ali（阿里正义）”。
raw: The president's televised address was interrupted on the internet for about a minute, and a group of black hackers against the Iranian government appeared on the screen, whose name was "Edalat Ali (Ali Justice)".

src: 还出现有一个声音高喊“伊斯兰共和国去死”。
raw: There was also a voice shouting "Death to the Islamic Republic."

src: 据路透社今天报道称，伊朗纪念革命周年，黑客中断国家电视台报道。
raw: According to a report by Reuters today, Iranian hackers interrupted the state television station's coverage of the anniversary of the revolution.

src: 伊朗官方纪念伊朗革命 44 周年，莱西的强硬派政府面临着要求他们下台的年轻抗议者提出的最大胆的挑战，但莱西仍然呼吁“受骗的青年”悔改，这样他们才能得到伊朗最高领导人的赦免。
raw: Iran's hard-line government faced its boldest challenge yet from young protesters demanding its overthrow on the 44th anniversary of the Islamic Revolution, but President Hassan Rouhani called on "deceived youth" to repent so they can be pardoned by Iran's top leader.

src: 22 岁的阿米尼 Mahsa Amini 于 9 月在该国道德警察的拘禁中死亡后，全国范围内的抗议活动席卷仍然在伊朗。
raw: Protests continue to sweep across Iran following the death of 22-year-old Mahsa Amini in custody of the country's morality police in September.

src: 伊朗安全部队对抗议活动进行致命镇压，这是伊斯兰共和国自 1979 年革命推翻 2500 年君主制以来面临的最强大挑战之一。
raw: The deadly crackdown by Iranian security forces on protests is one of the most formidable challenges faced by the Islamic Republic since the 1979 revolution overthrew 2,500 years of monarchy.

src: 作为纪念革命周年大赦的一部分，伊朗当局于周五释放了绝食抗议的被监禁的持不同政见者法哈德·梅萨米和伊朗-法国学者法里巴·阿德尔哈。
raw: As part of a general amnesty to mark the anniversary of the 1979 revolution, Iranian authorities on Friday released jailed dissident Farhad Meysami and Iranian-French scholar Fariba Adelkhah, who had been on hunger strike.

src: 稍早最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊 (Ayatollah Ali Khamenei) 发布了一项大赦令，其中包括一些在最近的反政府抗议活动中被捕的囚犯。
raw: Earlier, the Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei issued an amnesty decree, which includes some prisoners arrested during recent anti-government protests.

src: 据人权组织 HRANA 报告，截至周五，已有 528 名抗议者被杀，其中包括 71 名未成年人。
raw: According to human rights organization HRANA, as of Friday, 528 protesters had been killed, including 71 minors.

src: 报告说，还有 70 名政府安全人员被打死。
raw: The report also said that 70 government security personnel were killed.

src: 据信，多达 19,763 名抗议者被捕。
raw: It is believed that up to 19,763 protesters were arrested.

src: 数周以来，伊朗领导人和官方媒体一直呼吁在星期六的集会上进行投票，以表明反对抗议活动以及支持政府。
raw: Iranian leaders and state media have been calling for a vote of confidence in Saturday's gathering to show opposition to the protests and support for the government for weeks.

src: 在周五晚上的伊朗革命周年纪念日晚上，官方媒体展示了烟花作为政府赞助庆祝活动的一部分，人们高呼“Allahu Akbar！
raw: On Friday night, the anniversary of the Iranian Revolution, official media showed fireworks as part of the government-sponsored celebrations, and people shouted "Allahu Akbar!

src: （上帝是最伟大的！）”。

src: 然而，集会中也可以听到许多人大喊“独裁者去死！

src: 周六，政府电视台播出了全国各州官方集会的现场录像。

src: 在德黑兰，作为官方庆祝活动的一部分，展示了国产反弹道导弹、无人机、反潜巡洋舰和其他军事装备。
raw: In Tehran, as part of the official celebrations, domestically produced anti-ballistic missiles, drones, anti-submarine frigates and other military equipment were showcased.

src: 总统莱西的演讲经常被“美国去死”的口号打断——这是州集会上的标志性口号。

src: 人群还高呼“以色列去死”。

src: 她于 2020 年因国家安全罪名被判处五年徒刑。

src: 中国愿同日方一道，继续深化绿色低碳产业合作、技术合作、政策对话和人文交流，推动两国绿色发展合作不断迈上新台阶。

src: 重阳问答︱如何看待美国1月非农就业数据大超预期及未来趋势 - 经济观察网 － 专业财经新闻网站
raw: How to view the unexpectedly high US non-farm employment data in January and the future trend - Economic Observer, a professional financial news website

src: Q：请问重阳投资，如何看待美国1月非农就业数据大超预期及未来趋势？
raw: A: Regarding the unexpectedly high non-farm payrolls data in the US in January and the future trend, Qian Yinghui, CEO of Xiaomi, said that the company is optimistic about the future of the US economy.

src: A：2月3日美国劳工部公布2023年1月非农就业数据，新增非农就业51.7万人，大幅高于市场预期的18.9万人；失业率降至3.4%，为近50年以来的最低位；时薪同比增速4.4%，环比增速0.3%，略有放缓。
raw: A: On February 3, the US Department of Labor announced the non-farm employment data in January 2023, with 51.7 thousand new non-farm employment, which is significantly higher than the market expectation of 18.9 thousand; the unemployment rate fell to 3.4%, the lowest in nearly 50 years; the hourly wage growth rate was 4.4% year-on-year and 0.3% month-on-month, with slight slowdown.

src: 从总量上来看，本次数据存在很多一次性和技术性因素的扰动，比如罢工返岗的教职工、调查统计口径的修正、季调因子的更新，后续可能将有所修正（参考2022年1月新增非农由50.4万人下修至36.4万人），非农就业或不像数据体现的那样强劲。
raw: In terms of the total amount, there are many one-time and technical factors that affect the data, such as the return to work of teachers on strike, the revision of the survey and statistical scope, and the update of the seasonal factor. It is expected that there will be some adjustments in the future (refer to the new non-farm payrolls added in January 2022, which were revised from 50.4 thousand to 36.4 thousand); non-farm employment is not as strong as the data shows.

src: 从结构上来看，高科技企业裁员影响仍在，但占比较低；高接触性服务业如休闲酒店、教育保健等新增就业大幅回升，数据显示服务业劳动力缺口仍存。
raw: In terms of structure, the impact of layoffs on high-tech enterprises is still significant, but the proportion is relatively low; the newly added employment in high-contact service industries such as leisure hotels, education and health care has rebounded significantly, and the data shows that the labor shortage in the service industry still exists.

src: 结合同样大超预期的服务业PMI、岗位空缺和劳动力缺口数据的回升和消费信贷数据的强势，我们判断经过极端天气和节假日后美国服务业迎来了快速修复。
raw: Combined with the same large excess of service industry PMI, the recovery of job vacancies and labor shortage data, and the strong consumer credit data, we judge that the US service industry has undergone rapid recovery after extreme weather and holidays.

src: 我们认为，在不经过衰退的情况下美国就业市场的供需紧张难以改善。
raw: We believe that the tightness of the U.S. labor market will be difficult to improve without a recession.

src: 目前美国劳动力市场尚有500余万的供给缺口，而劳动参与率上行缓慢，尤其是25-54岁劳动参与率已经接近疫情前高点。
raw: There is still a supply gap of more than 5 million in the US labor market, and the labor participation rate is slow to rise, especially the labor participation rate of 25-54 years old has approached the pre-epidemic high point.

src: 除此之外，由于美国居民超额储蓄和消费信贷的强势，消费需求的强劲将促使紧缩政策对就业市场的影响进一步滞后。
raw: In addition, the strong consumption demand will further delay the impact of contractionary policies on the employment market, due to the excess savings and strong consumption credit of American residents.

src: 美国就业市场供需持续紧张将是2023年美国经济的底色。
raw: The supply and demand of the US employment market will continue to be tight, which will be the bottom line of the US economy in 2023.

src: 叠加目前临近加息结束，通胀预期不断反复，我们对薪资增速的持续下降并不乐观。
raw: The combination of the near-term end of the rate hiking cycle and the ongoing back-and-forth on inflation expectations has us less optimistic about the continued decline in wage growth.

src: 本次数据公布前，美国股债汇市场对于美联储加息路径的预期过于乐观。
raw: Before this data release, the US stock, bond and foreign exchange markets were too optimistic about the Fed's path of interest rate hikes.

src: 随着通胀数据的持续改善，美联储在缩短加息步伐的同时还不断维系着市场通胀预期脆弱的平衡，但市场对于美联储偏向鹰派的表述视而不见，不仅预期提前停止加息，还预期年末两次降息。
raw: As inflation data continued to improve, the Fed maintained a balance between shortening the pace of interest rate hikes and preserving the fragile balance of market inflation expectations. However, the market ignored the Fed's hawkish statements and expected not only an early end to interest rate hikes but also two rate cuts by the end of the year.

src: 在劳动力市场供需紧张，紧缩政策影响不明的情况下，我们认为美联储年末对于加息的指引是相对合理的，市场极端预期的调整和交易的拥挤或将对市场产生一定伤害。
raw: In the situation of tight labor market supply and demand and the unclear impact of tightening policies, we believe that the Fed's guidance on interest rate hikes at the end of the year is relatively reasonable, and the adjustment of extreme market expectations and the congestion of transactions will cause some harm to the market.

src: 尽管如此，薪资增速的顽固难改当前通胀快速下降的趋势，随着M2数据同比转负以及各个CPI分项领先指标的逐渐转好，自10月份以来美国CPI数据已经转向快速下降阶段，薪资增速的顽固仅会对以后的通胀数据形成托底，当前的市场预期难以证伪，在下一期通胀数据公布后市场或进入新一轮博弈。
raw: Despite this, the stubbornness of wage growth is hard to change in the current trend of rapid decline in inflation. With the M2 data turning negative year-on-year and the gradual improvement of various leading indicators of CPI, the US CPI data has turned to the stage of rapid decline since October. The stubbornness of wage growth will only provide a cushion for future inflation data. The current market expectation is difficult to be proved wrong, and the market may enter a new round of competition after the next inflation data is released.

src: 深圳：打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市-中新网
raw: Shenzhen: to build the first and leading ultra-speed pioneer city in China and the world - chinanews.com

src: 中新网2月11日电 据“深圳工信”微信公众号10日消息，深圳市工业和信息化局近日印发《深圳市极速先锋城市建设行动计划》。
raw: According to the WeChat public account of “Shenzhen Department of Industry and Information Technology” on February 11, the Shenzhen Department of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the “Shenzhen City Smart City Construction Action Plan”.

src: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
raw: By the end of 2023, a super broadband network with high speed, large capacity, and low latency will be built, and the network construction goal of "double gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, and all things connected" will be achieved, and a super-fast vanguard city will be built, ranking first in China and leading the world.

src: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
raw: The plan proposes to speed up the upgrade of the gigabit optical network.

src: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
raw: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of full-light industrial parks (industrial parks) will exceed 100.

src: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
raw: The plan requires a comprehensive improvement in the energy efficiency of 5G networks.

src: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
raw: Research and formulate Shenzhen 5G network service quality standards, carry out 5G network testing and evaluation, and improve the quality of 5G network services.

src: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
raw: Support basic telecommunications enterprises to increase the optimization of 5G networks in key regions and places, and add 10,000 new 5G base stations throughout the year. The average download speed in the city reached 500Mbps and the upload speed reached 100Mbps. The download speed in key regions reached 1000Mbps and the upload speed reached 200Mbps. The network speed and user experience have been greatly improved.

src: 打造城市级高品质无线局域网。
raw: Build a high-quality wireless local area network at the city level.

src: 制定公共场所无线局域网(WLAN)服务规范，推动全市各区人员密集和信息消费需求集中区域WLAN升级，提供千兆接入能力。
raw: Establish a norm for wireless local area network (WLAN) service in public places, promote the upgrading of WLAN in areas with high concentration of people and information consumption needs, and provide a gigabit access capability.

src: 依托“深i网”建设全市公共无线局域网统一认证监管平台，实现“一次认证、无感漫游、智能切换”，支持运营主体将具有公共服务能力的社会自建AP(无线接入点)纳入认证监管平台。
raw: Based on "Shen I Net", build a unified authentication and management platform for public wireless local area networks in the whole city, realize "one-time authentication, seamless roaming, and smart switching", and support operating entities to include social self-built APs with public service capabilities in the authentication and management platform.

src: 2023年底前，升级接入AP总量不少于2万个。
raw: Upgrade access to a total of no less than 20,000 APs by the end of 2023.

src: 此外，《计划》还提出，建设高品质全光运力网络、构建多层次算力供给体系、加快关键通信网络设施建设、提升互联网应用服务能力。
raw: In addition, the plan also proposes to build a high-quality full-light network, construct a multi-level computing power supply system, accelerate the construction of key communication network facilities, and improve the ability of Internet application services.

src: 《计划》明确，协同构建物联感知体系。
raw: The Plan clearly states that a cooperative construction of the Internet of Things sensing system should be carried out.

src: 探索以“开源鸿蒙”操作系统为基础，构建城市感知终端建设管理模式，降低对接成本，加快建设城市级物联感知平台，推动市区物联网平台、各领域专业物联网平台网络与数据互联互通。
raw: Explore the construction and management mode of urban sensing terminal based on the "open source Huangmeng" operating system, reduce the cost of connection, accelerate the construction of urban-level sensing platform, promote the interconnection of urban IoT platform, various professional IoT platforms, and data in various fields.

src: 深化物联感知在城市管理、民生服务、公共安全、交通出行等领域应用，拓展城市道路、建筑、公共设施等固定感知与智能网联汽车等移动感知采集渠道。
raw: Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in urban management, public welfare services, public security, transportation and commuting, etc. Expand fixed sensing and smart interconnected vehicles, etc. for mobile sensing collection channels.

src: 2023年底前，水电气物联网感知终端数量超过900万，打造20个多功能智能杆应用示范项目。
raw: By the end of 2023, the number of water, electricity, gas, and Internet of Things sensing terminals will exceed 9 million, and more than 20 multi-functional smart pole application demonstration projects will be built.

src: 《计划》还提到，加强卫星与地面通信融合应用、布局低空网络基础设施建设、推进海上5G网络深度覆盖。
raw: The plan also mentioned that satellite and ground communication should be integrated, low-altitude network infrastructure should be built, and 5G network coverage should be deepened in the sea.

src: 同时，推进海上5G网络深度覆盖、构建产业创新发展生态、支持举办顶级赛事和活动。
raw: At the same time, promote the deep coverage of 5G network in the sea, build an industrial innovation development ecology, and support the organization of top-level competitions and activities.

src: 中国电商行业涌现“新变量”，带货如何做到“内容为王”？
raw: How can Chinese e-commerce industry bring in “new variables” and make “content is king” a reality?

src: -中新网
raw: -China News Service

src: 中新网2月11日电 题：中国电商行业涌现“新变量”，带货如何做到“内容为王”？
raw: CNS website, February 11th, 2019

src: 中新财经记者 夏宾
raw: A CNCE journalist, Xia Bin

src: “我们入局电商算是晚的，但从最开始就意识到，想要从千千万万的店铺中脱颖而出，内容很重要。
raw: “We entered the e-commerce market late, but from the very beginning, we realized that content is very important if we want to stand out from the thousands of stores.

src: ”来自广东的“90后”女生芳芳，现在在抖音电商运营一家滋补食材店铺，让一家有着30多年历史的线下店在线上“开花”。
raw: Fangfang, a "90s" girl from Guangdong, is now operating a store selling nourishing ingredients on Douyin, making a "flowering" online of a brick-and-mortar store with more than 30 years of history.

src: 模仿老港片影调、配上经典粤语歌，打开@芳芳一人食抖音账号，精美的视频令人耳目一新。
raw: Mimic the old Hong Kong film style and add classic Cantonese songs. Open the @Fong Fong one person food TikTok account, and the exquisite videos are new to the eyes.

src: 在近日举行的抖音电商“寻找同行者·优质内容分享专场”上，芳芳作为优质创作者代表到场发言，介绍了日常创作的经历和体会。
raw: Recently, at the Douyin e-commerce “Find Peers·Quality Content Sharing Special Session”, Fang Fang attended as a representative of quality creators and shared her experience and feelings about her daily creation.

src: 她在现场说：“精心打磨的视频收获了很多网友的关注，好多人对我家的食材感兴趣，想跟着一起做美食，销路就一下子打开了。
raw: She said on the spot, "The carefully edited video has attracted a lot of netizens' attention, and many people are interested in the ingredients in my family and want to cook with me. The sales channels have opened up suddenly.

src: 芳芳靠着煲汤视频让更多人爱上“老广的味道”，一场直播最多卖出30万件滋补食材，挽救了家里濒临倒闭的老店。
raw: Fangfang used to make soup videos to let more people love the taste of "old Guangzhou". In one live broadcast, the most sold 300,000 pieces of health food, and saved the old store that was on the verge of bankruptcy.

src: “无内容，不电商”，随着短视频和直播电商不断发展，人们对电商内容的要求和标准正步入新阶段。
raw: “No content, no e-commerce”, with the continuous development of short video and live e-commerce, people’s requirements and standards for e-commerce content are entering a new stage.

src: 直播带货发展初期，直播间往往用低价折扣吸引用户，价格优势似乎成了当时的唯一卖点。
raw: In the early days of live broadcasting, live broadcast rooms often attracted users with low price discounts, and price advantage seemed to be the only selling point at that time.

src: 近年来，既有刘畊宏、东方甄选等现象级大V，也有在垂直细分领域出现的不少非大众所知的达人和商家，他们通过持续打造符合自己品牌调性的优质内容，提升长期经营效益。
raw: In recent years, there are both Liu Yahong and East Wind Selection, which are phenomenal big Vs, and many non-celebrity influencers and merchants who appear in vertical subdivided fields. They improve the long-term operating profitability by continuously creating high-quality content that matches their brand style.

src: 抖音电商明星作者运营负责人高亚轩介绍，过去一年有627万创作者通过抖音电商将内容变现，他们的内容创作量增长了252%，总成交额也翻了一倍以上。
raw: Haoyapen, the operation responsible person of the Kwai E-commerce Star Authors, introduced that in the past year, 6.27 million creators have made a living through Kwai E-commerce, and their content creation volume increased by 252%, and the total transaction amount has been doubled.

src: “在这些数字背后，我们能感受到一个蓬勃生长、具有旺盛生命力的作者生态。
raw: “Behind these numbers, we can feel a thriving and vibrant author ecosystem.

src: ”高亚轩说。
raw: "Zhao Yaxian said,"

src: 北京师范大学传播创新与未来媒体实验平台此前发布了《电商行业内容生态健康指数(ECHI)报告》，从数据维度解析了当前电商行业中“新变量”——优质内容的重要性，运用指数对国内27家主流电商平台内容生态情况进行了评估。
raw: The Communication Innovation and Future Media Experimental Platform of Beijing Normal University previously released the E-commerce Industry Content Ecology Health Index (ECHI) Report, which analyzed the importance of high-quality content in the current e-commerce industry from the perspective of data, and evaluated the content ecology of 27 mainstream e-commerce platforms in China using the index.

src: 根据上述报告的电商行业内容生态健康指数排名，抖音电商、快手、淘宝、拼多多、京东位居前五。
raw: According to the above-mentioned report on the health index of the e-commerce industry content ecology, the top five are TikTok, Kuaishou, Taobao, Pinduoduo, and JD.

src: 报告认为，电商行业内容生态是一个综合性概念，是将电商与内容进行整合，但并非所有内容都可与电商整合，好的PGC(专业生产内容)与UGC(用户原创内容)才是与电商进行整合的优质载体，内容平台价值越高，消费与推广的场景也就越来越丰富，电商植入的可能性也就越高，商业价值也就越强，这种公共领域和私人领域逐步集成分布的电商内容生产和内容消费的比例也就会越高。
raw: The report believes that the content ecology in the e-commerce industry is a comprehensive concept, which is to integrate e-commerce and content, but not all content can be integrated with e-commerce. Good PGC (professional content production) and UGC (user-generated content) are the quality carrier for integration with e-commerce. The content platform value is higher, the consumption and promotion scene is more and more rich, the possibility of e-commerce insertion is also higher, the commercial value is stronger, and the proportion of e-commerce content production and content consumption in the public domain and private domain will gradually be integrated.

src: 现场，北京师范大学新闻传播学院教授、中国传媒经济与管理专业委员会理事长喻国明对《报告》做了分析解读。
raw: On the scene, Professor Yi Guoming, the Dean of the School of Journalism and Communication of Beijing Normal University, made an analysis and interpretation of the Report.

src: 他表示，就内容价值而言，当前电商行业已经从“消费可及性”过渡到“消费品质化”阶段，优质、专业、差异化的内容是电商行业的“硬通货”。
raw: He said that in terms of content value, the e-commerce industry has now transitioned from "consumer accessibility" to "consumer quality", and high-quality, professional, and differentiated content is the "hard currency" of the e-commerce industry.

src: 同时，内容成为电商发展新阶段的根本和抓手，知识付费、专业性知识、KOL(关键意见领袖)等PGC内容开始在电商直播中成为标配。
raw: At the same time, content has become the fundamental and handle for the new stage of e-commerce development. Knowledge payment, professional knowledge, KOL (Key Opinion Leaders) and other PGC content have begun to become standard in e-commerce live broadcasting.

src: 展望电商行业的未来发展，喻国明提出两方面的建议。
raw: Looking forward to the future development of the e-commerce industry, Yu Kunming put forward two suggestions.

src: 一个是从内容结构提升的角度看，推动电商内容生态健康程度和质量整体提升，打造正向内容创作和管理标准，实现电商行业内容生态健康系统指数与动态均衡。
raw: One is to promote the health and overall quality of the e-commerce content ecology from the perspective of improving the content structure, and to build positive content creation and management standards to achieve a healthy system index and dynamic balance of the e-commerce industry content ecology.

src: 另一个是从外部生态看，要实现内容电商行业的健康发展和外部环境的价值协同与共创。
raw: Another is to look at the external ecology, that is, to achieve the healthy development of the content e-commerce industry and the value synergy and co-creation of the external environment.

src: “未来电商行业还需要更多的数据、人工智能方面的支持，形成对未来发展稳定性的预测；此外，为商家提供更规范、健康的成长空间，实现电商行业中企业、用户、产品与服务的价值协同，共创健康内容生态。
raw: In the future, the e-commerce industry needs more support in data and artificial intelligence to make predictions about the future development; in addition, it needs to provide a more standardized and healthy growth space for merchants to achieve value coordination among enterprises, users, products and services in the e-commerce industry, and jointly create a healthy content ecology.
" (completed)

src: （德国之声中文网）拜登政府本周五（2月10日）将6个与疑似参与间谍气球计划的中国实体列入黑名单。
raw: The Biden administration will blacklist six Chinese entities suspected of participating in the spy balloon project on Friday (February 10).

src: 美国商务部表示，这5家中国公司及1家研究机构帮助中国军队现代化，尤其是航空航天项目，包括飞艇和飞机。
raw: The US Department of Commerce said that these 5 Chinese companies and 1 research institution helped the Chinese military modernize, especially in aerospace projects, including airships and aircraft.

src: 被列入黑名单的公司很难获得美国的技术出口。
raw: Companies on the blacklist have a hard time getting U.S. technology exports.

src: 名单被称为“实体名单”（entity list），入列的公司除非获得美国商务部的特别出口许可证，否则将无法向美国供应商购买技术或商品。
raw: The list is called the “entity list,” and companies on the list cannot buy technology or goods from US suppliers unless they obtain special export licenses from the US Department of Commerce.

src: 被列入黑名单的公司是：北京南江空天科技股份有限公司、中国电子科技集团第四十八研究所、东莞凌空遥感科技有限公司、鹰门航空科技集团有限公司、广州天海翔航空科技有限公司和山西鹰门航空科技集团有限公司。
raw: The blacklisted companies are: Beijing Nange Aerospace Science and Technology Co., Ltd., 48th Research Institute of China Electronics Technology Group, Longkong Remote Sensing Science and Technology Co., Ltd., Yongmen Aviation Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd., Guangzhou Tianhai Xiang Aviation Science and Technology Co., Ltd., and Shanxi Yongmen Aviation Science and Technology Group Co., Ltd.

src: 在此之前，白宫表示考虑做出更广泛措施，“揭露和处理”中国威胁美国国家安全的更大规模监控活动。
raw: Before that, the White House said it was considering more extensive measures to "expose and address" China's larger-scale surveillance activities that threaten U.S. national security.

src: 气球事件引发中美之间进一步紧张，美国国务卿布林肯取消了访问中国的行程。
raw: The balloon incident caused further tension between China and the United States, and US Secretary of State Blinken canceled his visit to China.

src: 美国2月4日击落气球，中国政府向美国驻华使馆提出严正交涉，批评美国严重冲击和损害双方稳定中美关系的努力和进程。
raw: On February 4, the United States shot down a balloon. The Chinese government made a serious representation to the US embassy in China, criticizing the United States for seriously undermining and damaging the efforts and process of stabilizing Sino-US relations.

src: 从现有残骸证据及中国军方的采购平台资讯，美国政府得出结论，认为该气球的制造厂商“跟中国解放军有直接关系”，而且是中国军方批准的供应商。
raw: Based on the evidence of the existing debris and the information on the procurement platform of the Chinese military, the US government concluded that the manufacturer of the balloon was "directly related to the Chinese People's Liberation Army" and was an approved supplier of the Chinese military.
